column1: This contains a summary of all defensive modifiers to the chance to be hit by an incoming projectile. It assumes the standard base hit chance of 60%, and cannot take into account the many attacker-sourced and situational factors, thus it is not generally an accurate representation of the actual chance to be hit, instead serving to demonstrate the relative defensive value of certain circumstances and part configurations. Hovering the cursor over the window (or holding '\') opens the full details, which lists each component by name and will also indicate why a given value is grayed out (i.e. inapplicable). Note that while the summary window updates in real time, the details window does not (in the rare case that you're toggling parts while also holding that window open).
column2: 此窗口汇总所有影响来袭投射物命中你的防御修正。假设基础命中率为60%，但无法计入众多攻击者因素和情境因素，因此通常并不代表实际命中率，而是展示特定条件及部件配置的相对防御价值。将光标悬停在窗口上（或按住“\”）可打开完整详情，按名称列出各项，并说明数值变灰的原因（即不适用）。汇总窗口会实时更新，详情窗口不会（极少数情况下，你一边切换部件一边保持详情打开时尤其如此）。

column1: While in firing mode, the evasion window is replaced with the volley window, showing summary data for the volley if there are any active weapons. 'R' indicates the range from your current position to the cursor. Letters in brackets refer to all active weapons (using their parts list letter), where those which are not currently within range of the cursor target (and therefore will not fire) are grayed out. For all weapons that will fire, the total resource costs are listed in the second line: time required to fire along with energy ('E'), matter ('M') and heat ('H'). Energy and matter are displayed as total costs, while heat is instead the amount generated per turn over the volley duration.
column2: 处于开火模式时，闪避窗口会替换为齐射窗口；若有活动武器，此处显示齐射摘要。“R”表示你当前位置至光标的距离。括号中的字母对应所有活动武器（使用部件列表字母）；超出光标目标射程、因此不会开火的武器会显示为灰色。即将开火的武器，其总资源消耗显示在第二行：开火所需时间，以及能量（“E”）、物质（“M”）和热量（“H”）。能量和物质显示总消耗，热量则显示齐射持续期间每回合产生的量。

column1: At the bottom of that window is a button for toggling a visualization of the volley range (alternatively use the 'v' key) to highlight the area reachable by the current volley, using different levels of brightness if multiple ranges are involved. Any visible terrain destroyable using the volley (including generally taking into account all applicable damage modification from active utilities, current momentum, resistances, etc.) will glow red, while any other terrain that could at least theoretically be destroyed by currently inactive weapons or those in inventory will instead glow yellow. The appearance of terrain you don't likely have the means to destroy at the moment remains unchanged. Note that even in such a case, it may sometimes still be possible to destroy the terrain using other means, since the system does not take into account inactive utilities or those in inventory, special weapons, the environment, or other means to creatively destroy terrain, but it is a useful way to quickly confirm that you already do have the capability.
column2: 窗口底部的按钮可切换齐射范围可视化（也可按“v”），突出显示当前齐射可达区域；涉及多个射程时以不同亮度区分。齐射能够摧毁的可见地形（通常会考虑活动工具、当前动能、抗性等所有适用伤害修正）会发红光；理论上可由当前未活动武器或库存武器摧毁的其他地形会发黄光。你当前大概无力摧毁的地形外观不变。即使地形未高亮，也可能通过其他方式摧毁，因为系统不会考虑未活动或在库存中的工具、特殊武器、环境或其他创意手段；但该功能仍能快速确认你已具备的能力。

column1: On the top border of this area is current/max mass, and if overweight an "Ox#" indicator will appear in which '#' is the number of times you currently exceed your propulsion support limit, a vital factor in movement mechanics. If flying, the overweight indicator appears yellow since you lose your dodge bonus while overweight, and are no longer capable of flying over non-allied bots.
column2: 此区域顶边显示当前/最大质量。超重时会显示“Ox#”，其中“#”表示当前超过推进支撑上限的倍数，这是移动机制的重要因素。飞行时，超重指示会变黄，因为超重会失去闪避加成，也无法飞越非盟友机器人。

column1: To the right of each part is extra information about each depending on the current mode (coverage/energy/integrity/info). Info ('q') mode is the most esoteric, but provides a useful at-a-glance summary of stats relevant to each type of item, usually enough to make quick comparisons without opening the full info window. The first number for all parts is always the rating, preceded by a * if it's a prototype, or ** if an artifact. A '+' also appears before that to indicate when you currently have a schematic for that type of part, though note that in the case of a few late-game weapons, there may not be enough room in their summary to show the + reminder. Subsequent values differ by item type. All parts except propulsion indicate their mass with 'M'. Power sources indicate energy output with 'E'. Propulsion indicate base cost/move with 'T', and support with 'S'. Utilities show an ABBR/###, where ABBR is a very short four-letter abbreviation for its effect type, followed by the strength/value of its effect. Because each utility has only one primary type of effect, there isn't much point in learning to recognize those abbreviations (though there is a scheme to them). Instead the number is what's really important.
column2: 每个部件右侧会根据当前模式显示额外信息（覆盖率/能量/完整度/信息）。信息（“q”）模式最晦涩，但能快速概览各类物品的相关属性，通常无需打开完整信息窗口就能比较。所有部件的首个数值都是评级；原型前标“*”，神器前标“**”。若你已拥有该部件蓝图，前面还会有“+”；但少数后期武器的摘要空间不足，可能无法显示加号。后续数值因物品类别而异。除推进部件外，所有部件都用“M”表示质量；能量源用“E”表示能量产出；推进部件用“T”表示基础移动消耗、“S”表示支撑值。工具显示ABBR/###：ABBR是效果类型的四字母缩写，后接效果强度/数值。每种工具只有一种主要效果，没必要刻意记缩写（尽管其中有规律）；真正重要的是后面的数值。

column1: In Vulnerability ('c') mode, the graphs are derived from a combination of coverage and integrity, where those parts with greater vulnerability are more likely to be lost before others, statistically speaking.
column2: 弱点（“c”）模式中的图表结合覆盖率和完整度；从统计上说，弱点较高的部件更可能先被摧毁。

column1: In Heat ('e') mode, propulsion values reflect the amount of heat generated by a full turn of movement plus upkeep, and weapon values assume the weapon is fired alone in a 200-time volley with no further adjustments for delay or utility effects.
column2: 热量（“e”）模式中，推进部件数值表示完整移动一回合加维护所产生的热量；武器数值假设该武器单独进行持续200时间单位的齐射，不额外计算延迟或工具效果。

column1: Before the slot letter for processors and hackware is a dark ':', which is simply an indicator to remind you that removing or replacing that part will destroy it permanently.
column2: 处理器和黑客设备的槽位字母前有深色“:”，仅作提醒：移除或替换这类部件会将其永久摧毁。

column1: When a part is attached via the swap menu, replacing another part, in Tactical HUD mode a line marker appears to its left and will remain there for as long as the part it replaced is still available in inventory. This makes it easier to swap back and forth between a pair of parts, for example if you have a slightly different loadout for exploration vs. combat. When the swap menu is opened again for that autopaired part, the previous part to occupy that slot is also listed as part 'Y' for quicker selection. Mouse users can also simply left-click on the marker to perform the autopair swap. Holding Shift-Alt-a (or hovering the mouse cursor over one of those markers) causes the names of all autopaired parts to appear next to their counterparts.
column2: 在战术HUD模式下，通过交换菜单安装部件并替换另一部件时，新部件左侧会出现线形标记；只要被替换部件仍在库存，该标记就会保留。这便于在一对部件间来回切换，例如探索和战斗采用不同配置。再次打开该自动配对部件的交换菜单时，占用过该槽位的旧部件会列为“Y”，便于快速选择。鼠标用户也可左键点击标记执行自动配对交换。按住Shift-Alt-a（或将光标悬停在标记上）会在对应部件旁显示所有自动配对部件名称。

column1: Note that the order parts are listed does not matter, except in the case of weapons, where active weapons in a volley will fire from top to bottom as listed. Reorder weapons as necessary depending on the tactical situation. All parts can be autosorted by subtype with the ':' key, which by default will also sort weapons, but the latter behavior can be manually overridden with the partSortIgnoresWeapons in /user/advanced.cfg.
column2: 部件的排列顺序通常无关紧要；武器例外，齐射中的活动武器会按列表从上到下开火，应根据战况调整顺序。按“:”可按子类型自动排序所有部件；默认也会排序武器，但可在/user/advanced.cfg中用partSortIgnoresWeapons单独关闭武器排序。

column1: The list of inventory items displays used and free inventory space on its top border, and also inherits the current info mode of the parts list.
column2: 库存物品列表顶边显示已用和可用库存空间，并沿用部件列表当前的信息模式。

column1: Sorting by type, accessible via the bottom button/key, can also be reversed by double-clicking/pressing the same button/key.
column2: 可通过底部按钮/按键按类型排序；再次双击/按下同一按钮/按键可反转顺序。

column1: To tag an inventory item with a text note, use the Special Commands interface (Spacebar) or press Shift-Alt-t followed by its inventory number. This feature is generally used to tag unidentified prototypes and alien artifacts that are known based on other factors or meta knowledge, so that they're not lost in the inventory later. Adding a '!' anywhere in a tag, even by itself, has the additional functionality of forcing that item to require confirmation in order to attach it. Erase an existing item tag by entering an empty tag for it.
column2: 使用特殊指令界面（空格键），或按Shift-Alt-t后输入库存编号，可给库存物品添加文字备注。通常用于标记因其他线索或元知识而已知身份的未识别原型和外星神器，以免之后在库存中找不到。在标签任意位置加入“!”（单独使用也行），还可强制要求安装该物品前进行确认。输入空标签即可删除现有标签。

column1: Among the optional top-center windows is a log containing more specific combat details, the level of which can be set in the options menu. Reading it is not necessary since all vital data is conveyed via the regular log and on the map itself, but some players find additional details useful for learning purposes or exploring optimization strategies. At full detail this will give a complete breakdown of all hit chance modifiers factored into your attacks, represented as a string of abbreviations with the following meanings:
column2: 可选的顶部中央窗口之一是战斗日志，显示更详细的战斗信息，详情等级可在选项菜单调整。无需阅读日志，因为重要信息会显示在常规日志和地图上；但部分玩家会用这些细节学习或探索优化策略。设为最高详情时，会完整列出攻击命中率修正，以缩写串表示，含义如下：

column1: Be aware that internally the game uses decimals to calculate hit chance, so the values shown may be slightly inaccurate due to rounding.
column2: 请注意，游戏内部以小数计算命中率，因此显示值可能因四舍五入而略有误差。

column1: During your turn you can scroll the combat log manually to more quickly look through the combat history via an expanded view that appears over the map. The expanded combat log automatically disappears if you perform an action, or switch away from the combat log.
column2: 在你的回合中，可手动滚动战斗日志，通过覆盖地图的扩展视图快速查阅战斗记录。执行行动或切换离开战斗日志时，扩展日志会自动消失。

column1: If the log detail is set to Max, combat log contents are also mirrored to the left side of the map in order to show more at once, as the action plays out. Use /user/advanced.cfg to adjust the length (mapFullCombatLogMaxLength) and duration (mapFullCombatLogDuration) of the mirrored messages. This feature only applies to the Non-modal UI layout unless mapFullCombatLogOverride is set.
column2: 若日志详情设为“最高”，战斗日志内容也会镜像显示在地图左侧，以便行动进行时查看更多。可在/user/advanced.cfg中调整镜像消息长度（mapFullCombatLogMaxLength）和持续时间（mapFullCombatLogDuration）。除非设置mapFullCombatLogOverride，此功能仅适用于非模态界面布局。

column1: When viewing detailed info for a utility, their effect might be followed by one or more of the following indicators:
column2: 查看工具详细信息时，其效果后可能会显示以下一个或多个标记：

column1: Various temporary indicators may pop up for robots on the map:
column2: 地图上可能会短暂显示机器人的临时指示标记：

column1: * Numbers that appear next to a robot taking core damage represent its remaining core integrity. This can be reverted to non-Tactical HUD behavior by setting percentCorePopup in /user/advanced.cfg to show percent integrity instead, but in either case the color coding reflects how close they are to core destruction, by percentage. Sometimes more than one number may appear, indicating the same robot's core was hit more than once in rapid succession.
column2: * 机器人核心受损时旁边显示的数字代表剩余核心完整度。将/user/advanced.cfg中的percentCorePopup设为显示完整度百分比，可恢复非战术HUD行为。无论哪种显示方式，颜色都会按百分比反映核心距离被摧毁还有多近。有时会出现多个数字，表示同一机器人的核心在短时间内多次受击。

column1: * Combat robots glow red for a moment when they have reached critical heat and are ripe for meltdown by further thermal impacts. The glow only occurs on their turn, however, when they first pass the threshold.
column2: * 战斗机器人达到临界热量、进一步受到热伤害即可熔毁时，会短暂发红光。但发光仅发生在它们首次超过阈值的回合。

column1: * When first spotted by a hostile robot, a red '!' will flash on them temporarily.
column2: * 敌对机器人首次发现你时，其身上会短暂闪烁红色“！”。

column1: * NPCs with dialogue to speak show a flashing green '?'. The indicator is instead gray, and temporary, if the dialogue is pure lore that you have already read in a previous run. Note that in any of the areas with numerous NPCs to speak to, even among those with green indicators it is possible to distinguish pure lore from other benefits: Those which are roaming around will only provide lore, while lone stationary robots also provide you with something useful.
column2: * 有对白的NPC会闪烁绿色“？”。若对白只是你上一局读过的背景故事，标记会变灰并短暂显示。NPC较多的区域中，即使都是绿色标记，也可区分纯背景对白和其他好处：四处走动者只提供背景信息，独自驻守的机器人还会给你有用物品。

column1: * Hovering your examine cursor over a known Heavy position for a moment will show their sensor range for reference.
column2: * 将检查光标悬停在已知重型单位位置片刻，会显示其传感器范围供参考。

column1: The origins of sound effects heard but not seen are also temporarily marked on the map, and color-coded by type as follows:
column2: 未看到但听到的音效来源也会暂时标记在地图上，并按类型着色：

column1: This feature can be disabled via disableVisibleSfx in /user/advanced.cfg.
column2: 可在/user/advanced.cfg中通过disableVisibleSfx关闭此功能。

column1: Open spaces previously occupied by now-destroyed walls and earth have a slight glow to them. Consecutive moves through these unstable areas may cause a cave-in, but only if doing so for extended periods. Tunneling between rooms, or through a wall-earth-wall scenario, will not cave in.
column2: 曾被摧毁墙壁或土层占据的空地会微微发光。在这些不稳定区域连续移动较长时间可能引发塌方；在房间间挖掘，或穿过“墙-土-墙”结构，则不会塌方。

column1: You can export an image of the entire current map via the Special Commands interface (Spacebar), or by using the Shift-Alt-m command. The image is placed in a new /screenshots-maps/ directory and tagged with the map's name, depth, and current map turn number. This process may take a few seconds because it needs to sequentially render numerous frames across the entire map, compiling them together into a single PNG. Images exclude any temporary overlays and animations.
column2: 可通过特殊指令界面（空格键）或Shift-Alt-m导出当前整张地图。图像保存在新建的/screenshots-maps/目录，文件名包含地图名称、深度和当前地图回合数。由于需依次渲染整张地图的大量画面并合成为一张PNG，可能需要几秒。图像不包含临时覆盖层和动画。

column1: On entering firing mode via the 'f' command, the cursor will automatically shift to the most recent previous target, be it a robot or empty space, and any previous guided waypoints will be recalled (if still in sight). If there is no previous target, or it is no longer valid, the nearest target is chosen instead. Cycle forward and backward through targets sorted in near to far order via the Tab/Shift-Tab, -/=, and Numpad -/+ command pairs. Only armed hostiles are included in the cycle, or if none are visible it will instead cycle through all non-allied targets.
column2: 按“f”进入开火模式时，光标会自动移至最近一次的目标（机器人或空地），并恢复先前设置的制导航点（若仍在视野内）。若没有旧目标或其已失效，则改选最近目标。可用Tab/Shift-Tab、“-”/“=”及小键盘“-”/“+”在目标间按由近到远循环。循环仅包含已武装敌人；若没有可见武装敌人，则循环所有非盟友目标。

column1: Examine mode uses the same cycling commands, but always includes all non-allied robots, armed and unarmed. When the intent is to attack an unarmed target while other armed hostiles are visible, examine mode can be used as an alternative to cycle through both types of robots, and from there switch directly to firing mode once the desired target is reached.
column2: 检查模式使用相同的循环指令，但始终包含所有非盟友机器人，无论是否武装。若想攻击未武装目标而视野中还有武装敌人，可用检查模式在两类机器人间切换；选中目标后可直接转入开火模式。

column1: Note that item examination also allows the same near-to-far cycling scheme, but requires the Ctrl key (Ctrl-Tab/Ctrl-Shift-Tab and Ctrl-Numpad -/+).
column2: 检查物品也支持相同的由近到远循环，但需按Ctrl（Ctrl-Tab/Ctrl-Shift-Tab及Ctrl-小键盘“-”/“+”）。

column1: In Keyboard Mode, while either targeting or examining you can move the cursor more than one space at a time in a given direction by holding 'r' along with the desired movement command. This is compatible with vi-keys, arrows, and numpad/keypad, where the latter also has the option to use Shift as a modifier instead. The number of spaces per jump can be customized via the cursorJumpDistance option.
column2: 键盘模式下，在瞄准或检查时按住“r”并输入移动指令，即可沿指定方向让光标一次移动多个格。此功能兼容vi键、方向键和数字键盘；数字键盘还可改用Shift作为修饰键。可通过cursorJumpDistance设置每次跳跃的格数。

column1: When attaching parts from either the inventory or directly from the ground, if there are no available slots of the corresponding type, the interface will attempt to automatically pick a part to replace instead. Replacement candidates are prioritized in the following order:
column2: 从库存或地面安装部件时，如果对应类型没有空槽，界面会尝试自动选择一个部件替换。候选部件按以下顺序优先处理：

column1: * Replace an item of the same name that has a lower integrity. This process ignores non-functional parts since a player may have other reasons for owning them, so drop those manually if not needed.
column2: * 替换同名但完整度较低的物品。此过程忽略失效部件，因为玩家可能有其他理由保留它们；不需要时请手动丢弃。

column1: * Replace a different part that has the same type of effect, but that effect is not as powerful, regardless of the two parts' respective integrity. This mostly applies to utilities. If more than one part has the same effect type, it will select the one with the worst value, breaking ties by choosing the one with the lowest integrity.
column2: * 替换效果类型相同但效果较弱的其他部件，无论双方完整度如何。此规则主要适用于工具。若有多个同类效果部件，会选数值最差者；数值相同则选完整度最低者。

column1: * Replace a different part of the same subtype (ex: "Energy Cannon") where the old part has a lower integrity than any other of the same subtype with a lesser or equal effective rating. "Effective Rating" equals rating, +1 for prototypes. Ties among potential swap targets are broken by choosing the one with the lowest effective rating. This step is skipped by utilities and any parts with an effect, except treads. Weapon subtypes are compared and replaced only if they inflict the same type of damage. And because the only intent behind power source subtypes is to convey a general range of ratings, their subtypes are not treated as separate categories when analyzing potential replacement candidates.
column2: * 替换同一子类型（如“能量炮”）的其他部件：旧部件完整度须低于所有评级不高于它的同类部件。“有效评级”等于评级，原型额外+1。多个候选时选择有效评级最低者。工具和有特殊效果的部件（履带除外）跳过此步骤。武器只有伤害类型相同时才比较并替换子类型。能量源子类型仅表示大致评级范围，因此分析替换候选时不视为独立类别。

column1: * Armor without any special effect is replaced by other such armor, comparing purely for current integrity (rating is ignored, except to break ties).
column2: * 没有特殊效果的装甲仅与同类装甲互换，只比较当前完整度（评级仅用于打破平局）。

column1: If none of the conditions are met, it will simply report "No free slot." The list of rules is relatively short and basic because anything more results in too many complications and lowers predictability. Auto-replacement needs to err on the side of not swapping parts, so it's kept simple and predictable, based on only a few variables. To avoid smart replacement entirely, simply use the manual swap commands, or free the required slot first.
column2: 若以上条件均不满足，系统只会报告“没有空槽”。规则刻意保持简短基础，因为复杂规则会带来太多例外并降低可预测性。自动替换应谨慎，避免误换部件，因此只依据少数变量，力求简单稳定。若要完全避免自动替换，可使用手动交换指令，或先腾出所需槽位。

column1: Note that this feature only works for parts that occupy a single slot.
column2: 此功能仅适用于占用单个槽位的部件。

column1: Auto-replaced items are moved to the inventory, or if the inventory is already full, space will either be freed by comparing the item to all those carried based on the same rules above and drop a worse corresponding item, or where no comparison is possible, the replaced item itself is simply dropped.
column2: 自动替换出的物品会移入库存。若库存已满，系统会按上述规则与库存物品比较并丢弃较差的对应物品来腾出空间；若无法比较，则直接丢弃被替换物品。

column1: In addition to attached part replacement, when attempting to pick up an item and put it in a full inventory, the same rules are applied to auto-replace (drop) an applicable inventory item to make room for a better new one. Where no comparison is possible, the pick up action will simply fail with a message indicating the inventory is full.
column2: 除已安装部件替换外，拾取物品但库存已满时，也会按相同规则自动替换（丢弃）合适的库存物品，为更好的新物品腾出空间。无法比较时，拾取会失败并提示库存已满。

column1: In cases where no auto-replacement is found, quickly using the Get Item and Attach command a second time enters the modal ground swap menu if there are any applicable swap targets, enabling you to manually choose which attached part to replace with the item currently on the ground, bypassing the inventory.
column2: 若未找到可自动替换项，快速再次使用“拾取并安装”指令会打开模态地面交换菜单（若存在合适目标），让你手动选择要用地面物品替换的已安装部件，无需经过库存。

column1: In addition to the several adjustable itemLabel filters available in advanced.cfg, when mass labeling map items you can also limit the labels to those items belonging to a particular category, namely by each slot type (or non-part items).
column2: 除可在advanced.cfg调整的itemLabel筛选器外，批量标记地图物品时还可按类别限制标签，即按槽位类型（或非部件物品）筛选。

column1: After opening labels for all items, use Tab (or -/= or KP+/- or the mouse wheel) to cycle through the different categories, which will update the labels each time. Labeling categories also obeys the advanced.cfg filter restrictions, so the entirety of a particular category may not be available if some individual items were filtered out by your options. Consider using item searching to find such items more easily.
column2: 为所有物品开启标签后，可按Tab（或“-”/“=”、小键盘+/-、鼠标滚轮）切换类别，每次都会更新标签。类别标记也受advanced.cfg筛选限制；若选项过滤掉了部分物品，某类别可能无法完整显示。可用物品搜索更容易找到它们。

column1: The category filter will automatically reset to the default (all items) after ten seconds without use, or you can reset it manually by pressing Escape or removing all labels by repeating the labeling command.
column2: 类别筛选器闲置十秒后会自动重置为默认值（所有物品）；也可按Escape手动重置，或再次执行标记指令以清除全部标签。

column1: You can search through all known items on the map via the item search interface, activated via the Special Commands interface (Spacebar), or by Shift-Alt-f ("find"). This opens a new window over the right side of the HUD initially listing all known items, which can be shortened through a wide variety of filters.
column2: 可通过特殊指令界面（空格键）或Shift-Alt-f（“查找”）启动物品搜索，搜索地图上所有已知物品。新窗口会覆盖HUD右侧，初始列出所有已知物品，并可用多种筛选条件缩小范围。

column1: Simply typing enters text into the Search bar, where the most basic filter is text which must be found in the item name. For example "Imp" will list all items with the Imp. prefix, but technically also include "Impulse Thruster" (unless a period is added, of course, to search for "Imp."). Combine separate strings (requiring all of them to be present, but not consecutive) by using a comma. For example searching for for "par,char" would return any Particle Chargers. Searches are not case sensitive. Adding '-' before any text string excludes it from results, e.g. "-corr" would exclude corrupted parts.
column2: 直接输入文字即可填写搜索栏；最基本的筛选条件是物品名称必须包含该文字。例如“Imp”会列出所有Imp.前缀物品，但也会匹配“Impulse Thruster”（除非加句点搜索“Imp.”）。用逗号组合多个词，要求每个词都出现但不必连续；例如“par,char”可找到Particle Chargers。搜索不区分大小写。在文字前加“-”可排除结果，例如“-corr”会排除损坏部件。

column1: As usual, standard text editing commands are available, such as the Delete key, Arrows to move the cursor, and Ctrl-Backspace to erase the current text. The Enter key also simply resets the current search.
column2: 可照常使用标准文本编辑指令，例如Delete删除、方向键移动光标、Ctrl-Backspace清空当前文字。按Enter也会直接重置当前搜索。

column1: To search based on item properties other than name, special filters are available using the period prefix. For example ".power" will list all items that count as parts equippable to a power slot, or ".treads" will list all tread items. Generally only the first few letters are actually required to specify a particular filter, as indicated in the reference list below, but the full word is fine as well.
column2: 要按名称以外的物品属性搜索，可使用以句点开头的特殊筛选器。例如“.power”列出所有可安装在能量槽的部件，“.treads”列出履带部件。通常只需输入列表中指定的前几个字母，但也可输入完整词。

column1: Special search filters:
column2: 特殊搜索筛选器：

column1: Multiple special filters can be combined with one another, as well as used alongside name filters if desired, again using a comma to delineate separate filters. For example "rifle,.th" would list any items with "rifle" in the name which are also capable of dealing thermal damage. Or ".hov,5,70%" would list all hover propulsion of at least rating 5 with a minimum of 70% current integrity. Notice that it's not necessary to repeat the '.' filter prefix for subsequent filters.
column2: 可组合多个特殊筛选器，也可与名称筛选器一起使用；不同条件仍以逗号分隔。例如“rifle,.th”会列出名称含“rifle”且能造成热伤害的物品；“.hov,5,70%”会列出评级至少5、当前完整度至少70%的悬浮推进部件。后续筛选器无需重复输入“.”前缀。

column1: Left-click on a listed item (or use Ctrl-a~z) to center the map view on its location. While the map view is currently centered on a listed item, that item is marked with an asterisk in the list, and the shortest known path to reach it is highlighted on the map. Due to command conflicts not all of the various methods of panning the map are currently available while the search function is active, but mouse users can still hold Shift and move the cursor, and keyboard players can use mapshift mode as normal.
column2: 左键点击列表物品（或按Ctrl-a~z）可将地图视图居中到其位置。视图当前居中的物品会在列表中标星，已知最短路径也会在地图上高亮。由于指令冲突，搜索开启时并非所有地图平移方式都可用；鼠标用户仍可按住Shift移动光标，键盘玩家也可照常使用地图平移模式。

column1: Double-clicking on an item in the list (or repeating its Ctrl command) will automatically move to that item. (You can adjust the detection delay via itemSearchPathfindingDelay in advanced.cfg.) Depending on the current state of the map and its occupants, however, pathfinding may be interrupted along the way, especially for distant items.
column2: 双击列表物品（或再次按其Ctrl指令）会自动移动到该物品处。（可在advanced.cfg通过itemSearchPathfindingDelay调整寻路延迟。）但根据地图及其占用者的当前状态，寻路途中可能中断，远距离物品尤其如此。

column1: Items are ordered by their current direct distance from your position, near to far, not taking into account walls or available paths. Those items currently within Cogmind's FOV display their distance in blue, whereas those outside FOV display it in a shade of gray depending on distance. To the right of each item is its last known integrity, if available.
column2: 物品按当前位置到你的直线距离由近到远排序，不考虑墙壁或可行路径。当前位于Cogmind视野内的物品以蓝色显示距离，视野外则按距离以不同深浅的灰色显示。每件物品右侧会显示其已知的最近完整度（若有）。

column1: Comments can be added directly to any position on the map by activating the dedicated mode via the Special Commands interface (Spacebar) or Shift-Alt-c. Keyboard Mode can also directly add/remove comments while in look/targeting mode using c/r. Cycle through existing comments using Tab (+Shift reverses), and edit an existing comment by adding a comment at the same location. Even while outside comment mode, map positions containing comments will be highlighted intermittently as a reminder (this functionality can be adjusted via mapCommentHighlightInterval), and hovering the cursor over an existing comment's position will display that individual comment (if another labelable object currently occupies the comment's position, hovering always shows that by default and toggling all comments would be required to see such a comment).
column2: 可通过特殊指令界面（空格键）或Shift-Alt-c进入专用模式，直接在地图任意位置添加注释。键盘模式下，也可在查看/瞄准时直接按c/r添加或移除注释。按Tab（+Shift反向）循环现有注释；在同一位置添加注释即可编辑旧注释。即使退出注释模式，含注释的位置也会间歇高亮提醒（可用mapCommentHighlightInterval调整）；将光标悬停在注释位置会显示该注释。若该位置有其他可标记对象，默认始终显示对象标签，必须切换显示所有注释才能看到注释。

column1: In the lore collection interface, lore discovered via terminals is ordered alphabetically by topic, where the category simply refers to its origin. As a shortcut to finding a particular topic, type the first letter of its name to scroll to that section. Below terminal records is dialogue lore, organized by source. Their numbers have no significance and exist simply to serve as a distinguishing identifier for reference purposes. The last group are all robot analyses.
column2: 知识收集界面中的终端知识按主题字母排序，类别仅表示来源。要快速查找主题，可输入名称首字母跳至相应位置。终端记录下方是按来源整理的对话知识。编号没有特殊含义，仅作区分标识。最后一组是所有机器人分析。

column1: To the bottom right of the lore window is an export feature, convenient for those who wish to read their lore outside the game, share it with others, etc. Left-click a button or hit its corresponding letter key (shift for upper case) to immediately export your current lore to that format. The results are output to your /user/ directory. For export purposes, terminal records are reordered by category, and alphabetized within their category. As with the in-game UI, placeholders are shown for undiscovered lore in the TXT and HTML versions, though the CSV version solely includes your discovered lore. The HTML version is both colored and includes a table of contents with links to each section.
column2: 知识窗口右下角提供导出功能，方便在游戏外阅读或分享知识。左键点击按钮或按对应字母键（Shift为大写）即可立即按该格式导出当前知识，文件写入/user/目录。导出时终端记录会按类别重新排序，并在类别内按字母排序。与游戏内界面一样，TXT和HTML版本会为未发现知识显示占位符，CSV只包含已发现知识。HTML有彩色格式和目录，可链接到各章节。

column1: When manually updating to a newer version of Cogmind, records of previously collected lore are only retained across versions if you migrate your old /user/ data, specifically the progress.bin file. (Unless using Steam autoupdates or a -nonportable/custom file path, in which case this is handled automatically.)
column2: 手动更新Cogmind时，只有迁移旧版/user/数据（特别是progress.bin）才能跨版本保留此前收集的知识记录。（若使用Steam自动更新或-nonportable/自定义文件路径，则会自动处理。）

column1: All items attached across all runs are tallied in the gallery, which leaves empty spaces for those which have yet to be found. The parse_system robot hack may also be used on other robots to add their items to the gallery, especially useful when working with allies equipped with unique parts.
column2: 图鉴会统计历次游戏中安装过的所有物品，并为空缺的未发现物品保留位置。也可对其他机器人使用parse_system黑客指令，将其物品加入图鉴；与装备独特部件的盟友配合时尤其有用。

column1: To find a particular item more quickly, type the first letter of its name to scroll to that section. Note that this search method ignores name prefixes, e.g. if looking for a "Exp. Transmission Jammer" you should type a "t"; all of the jammers will be next to one another within the "t" section.
column2: 要快速查找特定物品，可输入名称首字母跳至相应位置。此搜索会忽略名称前缀；例如要找“Exp. Transmission Jammer”，应输入“t”，所有干扰器会集中在“t”栏。

column1: To the bottom right of the gallery window is an export feature, convenient for those who wish to review item stats outside the game or theorize about potential builds. Left-click a button or hit its corresponding letter key (shift for upper case) to immediately export your current item stat collection to that format. The results are output to your /user/ directory. Undiscovered items are not included in the export, nor are there placeholders for them. The CSV version is best for number crunching in spreadsheets, the TXT version lists items with only those stats which apply to them, and the HTML version is both colored and includes a table of contents with links to each slot type.
column2: 图鉴窗口右下方有导出功能，方便在游戏外查看物品属性或规划配置。左键点击按钮或按对应字母键（Shift为大写），即可按该格式导出当前物品属性集，文件写入/user/目录。未发现的物品不会导出，也不会占位。CSV适合表格计算；TXT仅列出各物品适用的属性；HTML带颜色和目录，可跳转到各槽位类型。

column1: When manually updating to a newer version of Cogmind, records of previously attached items are only retained across versions if you migrate your old /user/ data, specifically the progress.bin file. (Unless using Steam autoupdates or a -nonportable/custom file path, in which case this is handled automatically.)
column2: 手动更新Cogmind时，只有迁移旧版/user/数据（尤其progress.bin），才能跨版本保留此前安装过的物品记录。（Steam自动更新或-nonportable/自定义文件路径会自动处理。）

column1: Achievements earned throughout all runs can be browsed, filtered, and sorted in this interface.
column2: 此界面可浏览、筛选并排序历次游戏中获得的成就。

column1: All achievement descriptions refer to requirements that must be completed within a single run, except where otherwise noted or obvious. Some descriptions are hidden until earned, in order to avoid plot spoilers, or in a few cases to avoid revealing achievements that are fun to earn at random but otherwise boring to aim for. If a Steam player, it is strongly suggested to avoid third-party achievement managers that reveal all hidden achievements because most are spoilers. There is no need to expose and aim for any hidden achievement, as they are things you'll uncover naturally through regular play.
column2: 除非另有说明或显而易见，成就描述都要求在单次游戏中完成。部分描述会在解锁前隐藏，以免剧透剧情；少数成就隐藏是因为随机获得很有趣，刻意追求反而无聊。Steam玩家强烈建议不要使用会揭示全部隐藏成就的第三方管理器，因为大多会剧透。无需刻意寻找隐藏成就，正常游玩自然会发现。

column1: Achievement pop-up notifications are enabled by default, but can somewhat ruin the atmosphere at various points, especially where plot is concerned, so if you like they can be disabled in advanced.cfg by setting achievementPopupDuration to 0. Similarly, setting showAchievementMessages to 0 also prevents those messages from showing up in the log.
column2: 成就弹出通知默认开启，但某些时刻（尤其涉及剧情时）可能破坏氛围，可在advanced.cfg将achievementPopupDuration设为0关闭。同样，将showAchievementMessages设为0也会阻止成就消息写入日志。

column1: If playing on Steam there is bidirectional syncing of your achievements between each system, so if you reinstall Cogmind elsewhere it'll also download all previous achievements and include them in your local meta data (though in that case you'll have lost some info about your achievements like which game and highest difficulty level they were earned in, because Cogmind stores more achievement-related data than Steam's database). Playing the non-Steam version then later migrating over to Steam will also upload all previously earned achievements that are not yet earned on Steam.
column2: Steam版会在各系统间双向同步成就；在其他设备重装Cogmind后，会下载此前成就并加入本地元数据。不过Steam数据库比Cogmind保存的成就数据少，因此会丢失部分信息，例如在哪局、以何种最高难度获得成就。非Steam版之后迁移至Steam时，也会上传所有Steam上尚未获得的既有成就。

column1: All achievements are equally accessible regardless of difficulty setting. If for some reason you want to remove all your achievements, for example having earned many on lower difficulties and want to try again from scratch on a higher setting, add "resetAchievements=1" to advanced.cfg. This change cannot be reversed so you'd better be sure! The resetAchievements option is only valid for non-Steam players due to automated syncing while connected to Steam.
column2: 无论难度如何，所有成就都可获得。若想清除全部成就（例如低难度已获得许多，想在高难度重新挑战），可在advanced.cfg添加“resetAchievements=1”。此更改无法撤销，务必谨慎！由于Steam连接时会自动同步，resetAchievements仅适用于非Steam玩家。

column1: By default achievements can be earned even in challenge modes and special modes, but some are much easier in these modes compared to the regular game, even unintentionally, so a portion of players prefer to block them except when playing normally. You can do this by toggling "Achievements Anywhere" in the options menu.
column2: 默认情况下，挑战模式和特殊模式也能获得成就，但部分成就在这些模式中会更容易（甚至无意间就能完成），因此有些玩家希望仅普通游戏解锁。可在选项菜单切换“成就不限模式”。

column1: To the bottom right of the achievements window is an export feature, convenient for those who wish to review their achievements outside the game or maybe process them via other means. Left-click a button or hit its corresponding letter key (shift for upper case) to immediately export your current achievement list to that format. The results are output to your /user/ directory. Note that it only exports the currently listed achievements, so your filters and sorting do affect the results.
column2: 成就窗口右下方有导出功能，方便在游戏外查看或另行处理成就。左键点击按钮或按对应字母键（Shift为大写），即可按该格式导出当前成就列表，文件写入/user/目录。注意只导出当前列出的成就，因此筛选和排序会影响结果。

column1: When manually updating to a newer version of Cogmind, achievement records are only retained across versions if you migrate your old /user/ data, specifically the progress.bin file. (Unless using Steam autoupdates or a -nonportable/custom file path, in which case this is handled automatically.)
column2: 手动更新Cogmind时，只有迁移旧版/user/数据（特别是progress.bin）才能跨版本保留成就记录。（Steam自动更新或-nonportable/自定义文件路径会自动处理。）

column1: Alt-Tabbing between programs in Windows is known to cause issues with software that requires use of the Alt key. The software doesn't always know the correct state of the Alt key after performing such a command, and therefore may believe the Alt key is down when it really isn't. This can be extra noticeable in Cogmind's Keyboard Mode, which makes heavy use of the Alt key, by necessity. If you frequently Alt-Tab between programs, on returning to Cogmind you might want to tap the Alt key a couple times to make sure its state has been reset, otherwise you may accidentally enter an unintended command. It doesn't happen every time, but it's worth knowing that this is a possibility which can lead to otherwise confusing results.
column2: 在Windows中用Alt-Tab切换程序可能导致依赖Alt键的软件出问题：切换后软件有时无法正确识别Alt键状态，误以为按键仍被按住。Cogmind键盘模式大量使用Alt键，因此问题尤其明显。若常在程序间Alt-Tab，返回Cogmind后可按几次Alt确认状态已重置，否则可能误触指令。并非每次都会发生，但了解这一点有助于解释异常操作。

column1: There are a number of special options allowing finer control of certain features, or toggling very specific features some players might find useful. However, these options are only accessible via the /user/advanced.cfg file. As in other config files, binary on/off values are represented as 1/0. Make sure to only edit values while the game is not running.
column2: 部分特殊选项可更精细地控制功能或切换特定功能，可能对部分玩家有用，但只能通过/user/advanced.cfg访问。与其他配置文件一样，开/关值用1/0表示。请只在游戏关闭时编辑。

column1: * showClock: Adds a real-time clock to the top-right HUD area.
column2: * showClock：在HUD右上角显示实时时钟。

column1: * showRunTimer: Adds a real-time run timer to the top-right HUD area, displaying the current run time in hours:minutes. Excludes idle time, which doesn't count towards score sheet's run length tally.
column2: * showRunTimer：在HUD右上角显示本局实时计时（时:分）。不计入闲置时间，因此不会计入成绩表的本局时长。

column1: * renderFilter/renderFilterMap: See the later section dedicated to Color Customization under Accessibility.
column2: * renderFilter/renderFilterMap：参见“无障碍”下“颜色自定义”章节。

column1: * challenge???: Use these to activate individual challenge modes. See the manual section on Alternative Rules for a description of each.
column2: * challenge???：用于启用单项挑战模式。各模式说明见手册“替代规则”。

column1: * quickStart: When starting a new run, this automatically collects all parts and matter in the Scrapyard and puts you next to the exit. Does not work in the tutorial map or while any challenge modes active. Note if you're aiming for challenge achievements with propulsion-related restrictions, such as Mad Max, quickStart would prevent you from fullfilling those requirements. Using this option also prevents you from randomly meeting Revision 17 at the start again, which is itself an "achievement" to remind players of the initial plot hook.
column2: * quickStart：开始新局时自动拾取废料场所有部件和物质，并将你放在出口旁。教程地图或启用任何挑战模式时无效。若你在挑战成就（如Mad Max，限制推进类型），此选项会妨碍达成要求。它也会阻止你随机遇见Revision 17；这本身是提醒玩家初始剧情钩子的“成就”。

column1: * noSelfDestruct: Disables the self-destruct option in the game menu, as well as the corresponding hotkeys.
column2: * noSelfDestruct：禁用游戏菜单中的自毁选项及其快捷键。

column1: * noQuitDeleteSave: Disables the "Quit, Delete Save" option in the game menu, as well as the corresponding hotkey. Note that with this enabled, deleting a run in progress would require temporarily disabling this option, or manually deleting the save file.
column2: * noQuitDeleteSave：禁用游戏菜单中的“退出并删除存档”选项及其快捷键。启用后，删除进行中的游戏需暂时关闭此选项，或手动删除存档。

column1: * noManualSaving: Disables the buttons and commands for accessing the quicksave/load feature in Adventurer/Explorer modes.
column2: * noManualSaving：禁用Adventurer/Explorer模式中访问快速保存/载入功能的按钮和指令。

column1: * autosaveInterval: Autosaves your progress at most every X minutes, but only once idle for at least three seconds. If 0, will only autosave once at the beginning of each map.
column2: * autosaveInterval：最多每X分钟自动保存一次，但需至少闲置3秒。设为0时仅在每张地图开始时保存。

column1: * autosaveCount: Maximum number of previous autosaves to retain for the current run. In the event of a serious error with your save file, you can recover your progress by deleting your current save file (user/save_v[number].sav) and restoring one of the previous states named by order number and time stamp, where the highest number is the most recent. Simply rename it to match the deleted save file (save_v[number].sav). If 0 will never make backup saves.
column2: * autosaveCount：本局保留的历史自动存档数量上限。若存档严重出错，可删除当前存档（user/save_v[编号].sav），再从按序号和时间戳命名的历史存档恢复；编号最大者最新。将其重命名为被删存档的文件名（save_v[编号].sav）即可。设为0则不创建备份。

column1: * jsonScoresheet: Output local copy of scoresheets in JSON format in addition to the normal text version.
column2: * jsonScoresheet：除常规文本外，将成绩表副本以JSON格式输出到本地。

column1: * jsonStatDump: Output local copy of stat dumps in JSON format in addition to the normal text version.
column2: * jsonStatDump：除常规文本外，将状态转储副本以JSON格式输出到本地。

column1: * uploadScoresReminder: If upload scores option currently inactive, force message and audio feedback on startup, and upon entering -1.
column2: * uploadScoresReminder：若上传分数选项未启用，则在启动时及进入-1时强制显示消息并播放提示音。

column1: * ratingBasedItemSpriteColors: Color items visible on the map by their rating, rather than type. Toggling this off instead uses the ASCII coloring scheme for items.
column2: * ratingBasedItemSpriteColors：按评级而非类型为地图可见物品着色。关闭后改用物品ASCII配色方案。

column1: * itemLabelIntegrityPercentCutoff: When mass labeling map items, only label those with at least this integrity percentage (0 to label always label items regardless of integrity).
column2: * itemLabelIntegrityPercentCutoff：批量标记地图物品时，仅标记完整度至少达到此百分比的物品。设为0则无论完整度都标记。

column1: * itemLabelRelativeRatingCutoff: When mass labeling map items, skip those without an effective rating of at least the current map level minus this value. "Effective Rating" equals rating, +1 for prototypes. "Map level" assumes -10/Materials is level 1, and increases with each change in depth. For example, a value of 2 will only label items with a rating that at least matches two floors down, or better (e.g. at -5/Factory it will not label items with ratings from below -7/Factory). This setting does not affect non-attachable items or Relay Couplers, which are always labeled. And note that item labels ignore all itemLabel filters if mass labeling within 5 seconds of the previous mass labeling.
column2: * itemLabelRelativeRatingCutoff：批量标记时，跳过有效评级低于当前地图等级减此值的物品。“有效评级”等于评级，原型+1。“地图等级”以-10/材料区为1，每深入一层加1。例如设为2，则只标记评级至少达到低两层的物品（如-5/工厂不会标记评级低于-7/工厂的物品）。不影响不可安装物品或中继耦合器，它们始终标记。若距上次批量标记不足5秒，标签会忽略所有itemLabel筛选器。

column1: * itemLabelIgnoreFaulty: Don't label any faulty items when mass labeling map items.
column2: * itemLabelIgnoreFaulty：批量标记地图物品时不标记故障物品。

column1: * itemLabelIgnoreBroken: Don't label any broken or malfunctioning items when mass labeling map items.
column2: * itemLabelIgnoreBroken：批量标记地图物品时不标记破损或故障物品。

column1: * itemLabelHideRating: Don't include item ratings in map item labels.
column2: * itemLabelHideRating：地图物品标签不显示评级。

column1: * mapLabelsShowIntegrity: Item and robot popup labels also include the object's remaining integrity, if not currently at max.
column2: * mapLabelsShowIntegrity：物品和机器人弹出标签也显示剩余完整度（若未满）。

column1: * itemLabelIntegrityPercent: Map item labels show percentage integrity instead of raw integrity value. Requires mapLabelsShowIntegrity.
column2: * itemLabelIntegrityPercent：地图物品标签显示完整度百分比，而非原始数值。需启用mapLabelsShowIntegrity。

column1: * soundIgnoresDistance: Play all audible sound effects at the same volume, regardless of distance. (Setting has no effect on ambient audio from props, for which volume is always diffusion-based.)
column2: * soundIgnoresDistance：所有可听音效音量相同，不受距离影响。（环境装置音效始终按扩散决定音量，此项不影响它们。）

column1: * minimumPropVolume: A value from 0~100, setting the minimum volume at which to play ambient machine audio, regardless of distance. Set to 0 for default falloff behavior. Note that changes due to values greater than 0 are not reflected in the audio log, which still accurately reports volume levels relative to the actual distance, falloff, and other factors.
column2: * minimumPropVolume：设置环境机器音效的最低播放音量（0~100），不受距离影响。设为0则使用默认衰减。大于0的音量变化不会反映在音效日志中；日志仍按实际距离、衰减等因素准确报告音量。

column1: * examineEntersKeyboardMode: If not already in Keyboard Mode, entering examine (look) mode via keyboard automatically switches to Keyboard Mode.
column2: * examineEntersKeyboardMode：若尚未处于键盘模式，通过键盘进入检查（查看）模式时自动切换到键盘模式。

column1: * autoExitKeyboardMode: If examine mode was activated via the examineEntersKeyboardMode option, exiting examine mode will automatically toggle Keyboard Mode off again.
column2: * autoExitKeyboardMode：若检查模式由examineEntersKeyboardMode启用，退出检查模式时自动关闭键盘模式。

column1: * exitTargetingCentersCogmind: Exiting examine or targeting mode automatically recenters the view on Cogmind if not already centered.
column2: * exitTargetingCentersCogmind：退出检查或瞄准模式时，若视图尚未居中于Cogmind则自动重新居中。

column1: * noMouseWheelWait: Turns off the mouse wheel scroll-to-wait behavior (can be more appropriate for keyboard players with certain types of laptop trackpads that are easily touched unintentionally).
column2: * noMouseWheelWait：关闭鼠标滚轮滚动等待功能（适合某些触控板容易误触的键盘玩家）。

column1: * autoWait: When attempting to move but lack the energy to do so, automatically wait one turn.
column2: * autoWait：尝试移动但能量不足时，自动等待一回合。

column1: * slowMoveSpeed: Speed (in time units) slower than which movement will be temporarily blocked for 0.5 seconds while a warning message is displayed.
column2: * slowMoveSpeed：低于此时间单位速度时，移动会暂时阻塞0.5秒并显示警告。

column1: * extremeSlowMoveSpeed: Speed (in time units) slower than which movement will be temporarily blocked for 2.0 seconds while a warning message is displayed. Value should be set greater than slowMoveSpeed.
column2: * extremeSlowMoveSpeed：低于此时间单位速度时，移动会暂时阻塞2秒并显示警告。数值须大于slowMoveSpeed。

column1: * extremeSlowMoveSpeedBlockTime: Set time for which to override the normal 2.0-second block duration associated with extremeSlowMoveSpeed. Must be greater than the normal slow move speed block duration, 500ms.
column2: * extremeSlowMoveSpeedBlockTime：设置覆盖extremeSlowMoveSpeed默认2秒阻塞时长的时间。必须大于普通慢速移动阻塞时长500毫秒。

column1: * showOverweightMassThresholdRemainder: Changes the "Ox#" overweight indicator format at the top of the parts list to "X%Y", where X is the overweight multiple and Y is the amount of available mass support remaining before exceeding the next multiple and causing further speed reduction.
column2: * showOverweightMassThresholdRemainder：将部件列表顶部的“Ox#”超重标记改为“X%Y”：X为超重倍数，Y为达到下一倍数并进一步降低速度前剩余的质量支撑值。

column1: * focusPropulsionType: Attempting to attach any propulsion not of the specified type requires confirmation. Valid options include NONE/TREAD/LEG/WHEEL/HOVER/FLIGHT. This config option is useful when aiming for certain achievements or self-imposed conducts that require limiting oneself to a single type of propulsion throughout an entire run, to help prevent accidental usage of other types.
column2: * focusPropulsionType：安装非指定类型的推进部件时要求确认。可选NONE/TREAD/LEG/WHEEL/HOVER/FLIGHT。适用于追求限制全局推进类型的成就或自我挑战，避免误用其他类型。

column1: * movementDelayInterval: Delay (in milliseconds) for each space moved when keyboard running or mouse pathfinding. Minimum is 10ms, and note that the default 100ms is fairly appropriate to be both quick while still allowing time to react to the appearance of something of interest that doesn't normally automatically block movement.
column2: * movementDelayInterval：键盘奔跑或鼠标寻路时，每移动一格的延迟（毫秒），最低10毫秒。默认100毫秒兼顾速度与反应时间，便于应对通常不会自动阻挡移动的突发情况。

column1: * rulerBlocksMovement: Block movement commands while ruler overlay active.
column2: * rulerBlocksMovement：标尺覆盖层开启时阻止移动指令。

column1: * invertMapPan: Invert x- and y-axis shift directions when panning map (only affects mouse-based panning).
column2: * invertMapPan：平移地图时反转x/y轴方向（仅影响鼠标平移）。

column1: * disableShiftCursorMapPan: Disable the Shift-Move Cursor map panning feature.
column2: * disableShiftCursorMapPan：禁用Shift+移动光标平移地图功能。

column1: * viewFollowsCogmind: Always centers map view on Cogmind with every move.
column2: * viewFollowsCogmind：每次移动都让地图视图始终居中于Cogmind。

column1: * viewCenterpointSensitivity: Delay (in milliseconds) before holding RMB on the map will set a new map view centerpoint. Cannot be set below 100ms.
column2: * viewCenterpointSensitivity：在地图上按住鼠标右键多久（毫秒）才设置新的视图中心点。不能低于100毫秒。

column1: * viewCenterpointHighlightInterval: Interval (in milliseconds) between highlighting the current map view centerpoint when it is designated at a location other than Cogmind. This has no effect if viewFollowsCogmind is deactivated, or when no alternative centerpoint has been set. Setting to 0 disables this feature. Highlighting is not applied in Keyboard Mode.
column2: * viewCenterpointHighlightInterval：视图中心点设在Cogmind以外位置时，两次高亮间隔（毫秒）。关闭viewFollowsCogmind或未设置其他中心点时无效。设为0可禁用。键盘模式不显示高亮。

column1: * keyboardMoveViewCenterpointBehaviorFull: Determines how the map view centerpoint shifts while moving in Keyboard Mode with the map zoomed in. "INSTANT" immediately and fully shifts with each new move direction, "MIDPOINT" is like INSTANT but for 45-degree changes in direction will first shift to the midpoint between the old and new centerpoint, and "GRADUAL" shifts the centerpoint over multiple turns to gradually align with the new direction, also attempting to shift it to include extra spaces inside FOV where doing so won't cause other visible spaces to be moved out of view. "NONE" deactivates this behavior entirely. This setting applies only to the centerpoint behavior under the Non-modal UI layout.
column2: * keyboardMoveViewCenterpointBehaviorFull：键盘模式放大地图时，移动过程中视图中心点的偏移方式。“INSTANT”随每次转向立即完全偏移；“MIDPOINT”与INSTANT类似，但方向变化45度时先移至新旧中心点中间；“GRADUAL”用多个回合逐渐对齐新方向，并尝试纳入视野内更多格子，只要不会使其他可见格子移出视野。“NONE”完全禁用。仅适用于非模态界面的中心点行为。

column1: * keyboardMoveViewCenterpointBehaviorModal: As keyboardMoveViewCenterpointBehaviorFull, but applies specifically to Modal/Semi-modal UI layouts, which default to NONE because it is much harder to follow when so zoomed in.
column2: * keyboardMoveViewCenterpointBehaviorModal：与keyboardMoveViewCenterpointBehaviorFull相同，但仅适用于模态/半模态界面布局。此类布局默认设为NONE，因为放大时跟随中心点更难辨认。

column1: * keyboardMoveViewCenterpointOffsetLimit: Specifies the maximum distance from Cogmind that the map view centerpoint will be shifted while moving in Keyboard Mode with the map zoomed in.
column2: * keyboardMoveViewCenterpointOffsetLimit：键盘模式放大地图时，移动过程中地图中心点距离Cogmind可偏移的最大距离。

column1: * centerCursorOnMove: Always centers cursor on Cogmind while moving to properly update the Scan window with the item at the current location (only matters in mouse mode).
column2: * centerCursorOnMove：移动时始终将光标置于Cogmind位置，以便扫描窗口更新当前位置物品（仅鼠标模式适用）。

column1: * disableMouseMovement: Clicks on the map don't initiate moves or pathfinding in mouse mode. Note this will also disable the ability to path directly to items in the item search interface.
column2: * disableMouseMovement：鼠标模式下点击地图不会移动或寻路。也会禁用在物品搜索界面直接寻路至物品的功能。

column1: * shiftViewForEnemies: While the map is zoomed, or while using a Modal/Semi-modal UI layout, if new hostiles to label enter FOV but are currently out of view, the view shifts to include them if possible. "Move Block Duration" must be active in the options menu for this to take effect.
column2: * shiftViewForEnemies：地图放大或使用模态/半模态界面时，若新的可标记敌人进入视野但当前在屏幕外，视图会尽可能移动以显示他们。需在选项菜单启用“移动阻塞时长”才生效。

column1: * shiftViewForEvents: If any of certain events occur within FOV but are not currently in view, the view shifts to include them if possible, and pauses input for this duration (in milliseconds). Such events include Watchers sending out distress signals, being spotted by an active Operator, or pinging a special machine. Set to 0 to disable this feature.
column2: * shiftViewForEvents：视野内发生特定但当前屏幕未显示的事件时，视图会尽可能移过去，并在此时长内暂停输入（毫秒）。事件包括观察者发出求救信号、被活动操作员发现或扫描特殊机器。设为0可禁用。

column1: * dynamicPathDistanceHue: Visualization of longer paths to cursor position on map shift the hue to reflect greater distances.
column2: * dynamicPathDistanceHue：地图平移时，光标位置的远距离路径会改变色相以表示距离。

column1: * dynamicPathDistanceTime: Highlighting a longer path to cursor position with Ctrl-Alt also shows the total time required to move there given current speed.
column2: * dynamicPathDistanceTime：按住Ctrl-Alt高亮光标处的长路径时，也显示按当前速度抵达所需时间。

column1: * blockCaveinAreasForPathfinding: Pathfinding never allowed to move through potential cave-in locations unless immediately adjacent to starting position.
column2: * blockCaveinAreasForPathfinding：寻路不会穿过可能塌方的区域，除非该区域紧邻起点。

column1: * warnOnCaveinMove: Require confirmation when consecutive moves into a new destroyed area might begin to cause cave-ins.
column2: * warnOnCaveinMove：连续移动进入新坍塌区域可能引发塌方时要求确认。

column1: * warnOnMoveOutsideMapView: Moving while positioned outside map view requires confirmation.
column2: * warnOnMoveOutsideMapView：位于地图视野外时移动需确认。

column1: * rmbWallsToTarget: Mouse users can right-click on walls to enter targeting mode.
column2: * rmbWallsToTarget：鼠标用户可右键点击墙壁进入瞄准模式。

column1: * noMouseWarp: Blocks the cursor from being automatically moved when otherwise convenient. (No effect in Keyboard Mode, where this happens by default.)
column2: * noMouseWarp：在方便时也不自动移动光标。（键盘模式默认如此，此项无效。）

column1: * cursorVisibleDuringAttack: Overrides cursor hiding behavior during Cogmind attacks, keeping it visible.
column2: * cursorVisibleDuringAttack：覆盖Cogmind攻击时隐藏光标的行为，让光标保持可见。

column1: * cursorAlwaysHiddenWhenInputBlocked: Hide cursor any time input is blocked, such as during any attacks or map event animations. Overrides cursorVisibleDuringAttack setting.
column2: * cursorAlwaysHiddenWhenInputBlocked：输入受阻时隐藏光标，例如攻击或地图事件动画期间。覆盖cursorVisibleDuringAttack设置。

column1: * noRewireRepeatProtection: Disable protection against "over-moving" caused by holding a move key to repeatedly rewire an adjacent robot or trap.
column2: * noRewireRepeatProtection：禁用保护机制，避免按住移动键重复重接相邻机器人或陷阱时“移动过头”。

column1: * autoOpenNewIntel: Automatically switch to Intel window in response to gaining new intel. Not applicable in Modal UI layout.
column2: * autoOpenNewIntel：获得新情报时自动切换到情报窗口。模态界面布局不适用。

column1: * warningGlow: Animate UI borders based on current relevant status, where applicable.
column2: * warningGlow：按当前相关状态为适用的界面边框添加动画。

column1: * hitChanceVolleyAverage: Hit chance popups appearing next to hostiles in targeting mode report average hit chance for all active weapons in range of target in the current volley, instead of the base hit chance before applying any weapon-specific modifiers.
column2: * hitChanceVolleyAverage：瞄准模式中敌人旁的命中率弹窗，显示当前齐射中射程内所有活动武器的平均命中率，而非应用武器专属修正前的基础命中率。

column1: * percentCorePopup: In Tactical HUD mode, force core integrity popups that appear next to robots taking damage to display as a percentage rather than actual integrity.
column2: * percentCorePopup：战术HUD中，强制机器人受损时旁边的核心完整度弹窗显示百分比而非实际数值。

column1: * condensePartCategoryHeaders: In Modal/Semi-modal UI layouts, remove parts list slot type headers when doing so will delay the inventory window from switching to modal form. During this period, categories are instead reflected by bars of alternating brightness along the sides which double as cycle buttons for mouse users.
column2: * condensePartCategoryHeaders：模态/半模态界面中，若隐藏部件列表的槽位类型标题可使库存窗口更快切换为模态形式，则隐藏标题。此期间类别改由两侧交替亮度的条形表示，也可作为鼠标类别切换按钮。

column1: * alwaysCondensePartCategoryHeaders: Regardless of current slot count, always hide parts list slot type headers in Modal/Semi-modal UI layouts.
column2: * alwaysCondensePartCategoryHeaders：无论当前槽位数多少，模态/半模态布局中始终隐藏部件列表的槽位类型标题。

column1: * partDamageIndicatorsRetained: In Tactical HUD mode, damaged parts retain a box around their integrity indicator until your next action.
column2: * partDamageIndicatorsRetained：战术HUD中，受损部件的完整度指示框会保留至你的下一次行动。

column1: * precisePartGraphs: Part list data visualizations also show precise numbers in most modes (Tactical HUD only).
column2: * precisePartGraphs：大多数模式下，部件列表可视化数据也显示精确数值（仅战术HUD）。

column1: * noPreciseCoverage: Part list coverage visualization doesn't show precise values, even with Tactical HUD active and regardless of precisePartGraphs setting.
column2: * noPreciseCoverage：即使启用战术HUD，也不在部件列表覆盖率图中显示精确数值；不受precisePartGraphs设置影响。

column1: * partEnergyGraphAltColor: Part list energy visualization uses orange instead of blue to represent energy drain.
column2: * partEnergyGraphAltColor：部件列表能量图用橙色而非蓝色表示能量消耗。

column1: * partSortIgnoresWeapons: Ignore all weapon slots for part list sorting purposes, allowing complete manual control of volley firing order.
column2: * partSortIgnoresWeapons：排序部件列表时忽略所有武器槽位，便于完全手动控制齐射顺序。

column1: * partSortSeparatesDestroyOnRemoval: Part list sorting moves all nonremovable and fragile parts such as Processors to the top of their slot category, maintaining their relative order.
column2: * partSortSeparatesDestroyOnRemoval：排序时将不可移除或易损部件（如处理器）移至槽位类别顶部，同时保持彼此顺序。

column1: * ignoreDestroyOnRemovalConfirmation: Bypasses all confirmation requirements when a fragile or fused part will be removed. While convenient in some cases, disabling the warning feature is very dangerous!
column2: * ignoreDestroyOnRemovalConfirmation：移除易损或融合部件时跳过所有确认。某些情况下虽方便，但关闭警告非常危险！

column1: * matchSortInventory: Opening any item's info automatically orders the inventory to list all same-type items at the top.
column2: * matchSortInventory：打开任意物品信息时，自动将同类型物品排到库存列表顶部。

column1: * dragDropDelay: Delay (in milliseconds) after left-clicking on an attached part or inventory item before the drag-drop UI kicks in. Note that regardless of delay settings, drag-drop mode is also immediately activated as soon the cursor moves out of the item's button area while LMB depressed.
column2: * dragDropDelay：左键点击已安装部件或库存物品后，拖放界面启动前的延迟（毫秒）。无论延迟设置如何，按住左键时光标一旦移出物品按钮区域，拖放模式会立即启动。

column1: * dragDropTimeout: Delay (in milliseconds) after which holding the same item for a drag-drop action will automatically cancel the action. This defaults to 5000ms as a safety measure, where significantly lengthening it could theoretically cause problems in rare cases if there is some input detection issue.
column2: * dragDropTimeout：拖放操作按住同一物品多久后自动取消（毫秒）。默认5000毫秒作为安全措施；极少数输入检测异常时，大幅延长可能导致问题。

column1: * disableDragDropAutoEquip: Drag-dropping an inventory part to a non-slot location in parts list will not attempt to find an auto-equip solution anyway.
column2: * disableDragDropAutoEquip：将库存部件拖到部件列表非槽位区域时，不再尝试自动装备。

column1: * showPartRange: Circles the maximum range of weapons (and some utilities) on the map while the cursor hovers over that item in the parts list.
column2: * showPartRange：光标悬停部件列表中的武器（及部分工具）时，在地图上圈出其最大射程。

column1: * animateVolleyRange: Animate the volley range visualization when activated (otherwise the indicator appears instantly).
column2: * animateVolleyRange：启用齐射范围可视化时播放动画（否则立即显示）。

column1: * cursorJumpDistance: Distance in cells for commands such as jump shifting the examine or targeting cursor in Keyboard Mode. Accepts values from 2 to 20.
column2: * cursorJumpDistance：键盘模式中，跳跃等指令移动检查/瞄准光标的格数。可设为2至20。

column1: * mapViewShiftJumpDistance: Distance in cells to shift the map for each use of keyboard-based panning. Accepts values from 2 to 20.
column2: * mapViewShiftJumpDistance：每次用键盘平移地图时移动的格数。可设为2至20。

column1: * forceAsciiMachines: Always display machines using the original CP437 line art, even in sprite mode.
column2: * forceAsciiMachines：即使使用精灵模式，也始终以原始CP437线条图显示机器。

column1: * markUndiscoveredLore: Put a '!' marker before undiscovered lore listed on a terminal.
column2: * markUndiscoveredLore：在终端列出的未发现知识前加“！”标记。

column1: * hudEnergyPerMoveTurnwise: Replace per-move HUD net energy display with turnwise value including movement.
column2: * hudEnergyPerMoveTurnwise：将HUD每步净能量显示改为包含移动消耗的每回合数值。

column1: * hudHeatPerMoveTurnwise: Replace per-move HUD net heat display with turnwise value including movement.
column2: * hudHeatPerMoveTurnwise：将HUD每步净热量显示改为包含移动产热的每回合数值。

column1: * autoDeactivateSiegeModeOnMove: Attempting to move while in siege mode, or transitioning to it, automatically begins transitioning out of the mode instead of warning. Setting also applies to shielding mode.
column2: * autoDeactivateSiegeModeOnMove：攻城模式中尝试移动，或正在切换至攻城模式时，自动开始退出该模式，而非显示警告。也适用于屏蔽模式。

column1: * autoActivateTreadsOnAttack: Attacking automatically activates any attached treads if possible. If not originally using treads to move, then the next attempt to move will also automatically restore the original movement mode.
column2: * autoActivateTreadsOnAttack：攻击时尽可能自动启用已安装履带。若此前未用履带移动，下次尝试移动时也会自动恢复原移动模式。

column1: * autoReadyLauncher: Activating a launcher automatically deactivates all other non-launcher weapons.
column2: * autoReadyLauncher：启动发射器时，自动停用所有其他非发射器武器。

column1: * autoUnreadyLauncher: Detaching or swapping out a launcher automatically activates all non-launcher projectile weapons, excluding datajacks, guided weapons, and autonomous weapons.
column2: * autoUnreadyLauncher：拆下或交换发射器时，自动启动所有非发射器投射武器，但不包括数据接口、制导武器及自主武器。

column1: * warnOnInventoryItemDropOnItem: Require confirmation when manually dropping an item from inventory onto an item already at current position on the ground.
column2: * warnOnInventoryItemDropOnItem：手动将库存物品丢到当前位置地面已有物品上时要求确认。

column1: * remindOnLeavingDroppedContainer: Require confirmation when moving off of resource containers that were not empty when previously dropped.
column2: * remindOnLeavingDroppedContainer：离开此前丢下且仍有内容的资源容器时要求确认。

column1: * animateMapIntro: Animates the map intro on each new level (i.e. the map scan effect).
column2: * animateMapIntro：每进入新层时播放地图开场动画（即地图扫描效果）。

column1: * showMapBorders: Reveals all edges of the current map. Although this same information can be learned indirectly by attempting to pan around or use certain other UI features, and therefore it should be on by default, it's a deactivated advanced option because on a few maps using this will result in spoilers. It is suggested to instead consider leaving this off until you have already fully explored the world and are familiar with its secrets.
column2: * showMapBorders：显示当前地图所有边界。虽然可通过平移或其他界面功能间接获知边界，本应默认开启，但少数地图会因此剧透，所以作为高级选项默认关闭。建议先充分探索世界并熟悉秘密后再考虑开启。

column1: * highlightCaveinAreas: Fully highlights any visible cave-in areas rather than the low-distraction default, equivalent to holding Ctrl-Alt. Not compatible with LOW_CONTRAST render filters.
column2: * highlightCaveinAreas：完整高亮所有可见塌方区域，而非默认的低干扰显示，效果等同按住Ctrl-Alt。与LOW_CONTRAST渲染滤镜不兼容。

column1: * disableTerrainScanAnimation: Players distracted by the flashing of cells revealed or rechecked by an active Terrain Scanner can disable that animation.
column2: * disableTerrainScanAnimation：若活动地形扫描器揭示或重新扫描格子时闪烁动画造成干扰，可关闭该动画。

column1: * alwaysShowHeavySensorRanges: Persistently highlights all known Heavy sensor ranges without having to hover cursor over them.
column2: * alwaysShowHeavySensorRanges：持续高亮所有已知重型单位的传感器范围，无需悬停光标。

column1: * autocommentHeavies: Upon seeing a stationary Heavy or detecting one via sensors, automatically add a map comment at its location. Comments added in this manner are not removed in the event of a security rotation, as those known locations may remain relevant.
column2: * autocommentHeavies：看到静止重型单位或通过传感器发现它时，自动在其位置添加地图注释。安保轮换后也不会移除，因为已知位置可能仍有用。

column1: * autocommentBehemoths: Upon seeing a stationary Behemoth or detecting one via sensors, automatically add a map comment at its location.
column2: * autocommentBehemoths：看到静止巨像或通过传感器发现它时，自动在其位置添加地图注释。

column1: * autocommentSentries: Upon seeing a stationary Sentry or detecting one via sensors, automatically add a map comment at its location.
column2: * autocommentSentries：看到静止哨兵或通过传感器发现它时，自动在其位置添加地图注释。

column1: * mapCommentHighlightInterval: Interval (in milliseconds) between highlighting the positions of any manual map comments. Setting to 0 disables this feature.
column2: * mapCommentHighlightInterval：手动地图注释位置的高亮间隔（毫秒）。设为0可禁用。

column1: * mapCommentsPersistent: Even while not in comment mode, the text of map comments will also be shown alongside location markers. This text is hidden whenever any temporary object labels are showing, or in any targeting mode.
column2: * mapCommentsPersistent：即使不在注释模式，位置标记旁也显示地图注释文本。显示临时对象标签或处于任意瞄准模式时会隐藏。

column1: * modifiedTncPopupDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) for which data windows made available by the Modified TNC will remain visible.
column2: * modifiedTncPopupDuration：改造型TNC提供的数据窗口保持可见的时长（毫秒）。

column1: * scrapEnginePopupDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) for which the Scrap Engine resources window remains visible when its contents change, or each time COLLECT mode is toggled on.
column2: * scrapEnginePopupDuration：废料引擎资源窗口在内容变化或切换至COLLECT模式后保持可见的时长（毫秒）。

column1: * itemSearchPathfindingDelay: The maximum delay (in milliseconds) between commands in order to detect a double-click (or repeated key command) for the purpose of pathfinding to an item search target. Setting to 0 disables this feature.
column2: * itemSearchPathfindingDelay：检测双击（或重复按键指令）并寻路至搜索物品目标的最大指令间隔（毫秒）。设为0可禁用。

column1: * activeSensorPathNewDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) over which to fade activity cells newly discovered by an Active Sensor Suite.
column2: * activeSensorPathNewDuration：主动传感器套件新发现活动格子的淡出时长（毫秒）。

column1: * activeSensorPathsDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) for which Active Sensor Suite activity paths remain at maximum brightness. This time is automatically tripled while panning the map.
column2: * activeSensorPathsDuration：主动传感器套件活动路径保持最高亮度的时长（毫秒）。平移地图时该时长自动延长至三倍。

column1: * alphabetizeCouplerHacks: Sorts coupler-based robot hacks alphabetically rather than by cost.
column2: * alphabetizeCouplerHacks：将耦合器机器人黑客指令按字母排序，而非按消耗排序。

column1: * messageLogLimit: Maximum number of past messages stored for the message log. Must range from 500~100,000, or set to 0 for unlimited length. Note that high values allow very long runs to create large slow-loading save files.
column2: * messageLogLimit：消息日志保存的历史消息数上限。范围500~100,000；设为0则不限。高数值可能使长局存档变大、载入变慢。

column1: * combatLogLimit: Maximum number of past message stored for the combat log. Must range from 100~5,000, or set to 0 for unlimited length. Note that high values allow very long runs to create large slow-loading save files.
column2: * combatLogLimit：战斗日志保存的历史消息数上限。范围100~5,000；设为0则不限。高数值可能使长局存档变大、载入变慢。

column1: * combatLogOutput: Output the entire combat log at the end of a run or as part of a manual stat dump. The format is determined by the message log output setting in the options menu, so requires that to be active as well.
column2: * combatLogOutput：在单局结束时或手动状态转储中输出完整战斗日志。格式由选项菜单中的消息日志输出设置决定，因此也须启用该选项。

column1: * combatLogStreaming: Output the entire combat log as messages are generated, for external realtime monitoring and processing. Messages are appended to "user/combat_log_stream.txt"
column2: * combatLogStreaming：生成消息时实时输出完整战斗日志，供外部监控和处理。消息追加至“user/combat_log_stream.txt”。

column1: * noFluffLogMessages: Don't show a handful of potentially repetitive log messages meant mostly for atmospheric purposes.
column2: * noFluffLogMessages：隐藏少数可能重复、主要用于营造氛围的日志消息。

column1: * machineAnalysisLogsNoninteractive: Machine Analyzers will also report non-interactive machine discoveries to the message log.
column2: * machineAnalysisLogsNoninteractive：机器分析器也会将非交互式机器发现记录到消息日志。

column1: * disableMessageLogTurnNumbers/disableCombatLogTurnNumbers: Don't prefix log lines with the number of the turn on which that event occurred.
column2: * disableMessageLogTurnNumbers/disableCombatLogTurnNumbers：不在日志行前显示事件发生回合数。

column1: * reportBotnetSupportedSuccess: Successful hacks that would've failed without current botnet support are indicated after hacking.
column2: * reportBotnetSupportedSuccess：成功黑客入侵若需依靠当前僵尸网络支援才会成功，会在入侵后提示。

column1: * reportBotnetInsufficientFailure: Failed hacks that would've succeeded with more botnet support (up to a maximum of three linked Terminals) are indicated after hacking.
column2: * reportBotnetInsufficientFailure：黑客入侵失败但增加僵尸网络支援（最多连接3个终端）即可成功时，会在入侵后提示。

column1: * showBuildType: Cogmind will intermittently analyze your current build and assign a name to it, displaying it above the parts list. Updating is lagged to make it more reliable.
column2: * showBuildType：Cogmind会定期分析当前配置并命名，显示在部件列表上方。更新有延迟以提高可靠性。

column1: * showAchievementMessages: Message log achievement messages can be turned off to retain the original more immersive experience.
column2: * showAchievementMessages：关闭消息日志中的成就消息，以保留原本更具沉浸感的体验。

column1: * achievementPopupDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) for which each achievement popup will remain visible over the map. Setting to 0 prevents the popups from showing at all (this also affects whether any show on the game over screen).
column2: * achievementPopupDuration：成就弹窗在地图上显示的时长（毫秒）。设为0可完全禁用，包括游戏结束画面。

column1: * mapFullCombatLogMaxLength: Determines the maximum number of combat log lines automatic displayed at once on the left side of map (requires full combat log detail setting in options). The value must be between 10 and 48 (inclusive), though setting to 0 deactivates on-map log mirroring completely. Only compatible with Non-modal UI layout unless mapFullCombatLogOverride set.
column2: * mapFullCombatLogMaxLength：设置地图左侧自动显示的战斗日志行数上限（需在选项中启用完整战斗日志详情）。范围10至48（含）；设为0可完全关闭地图镜像。仅支持非模态界面布局，除非启用mapFullCombatLogOverride。

column1: * mapFullCombatLogDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) before a given line of the above on-map combat log data will disappear.
column2: * mapFullCombatLogDuration：上述地图战斗日志每行消失前显示的时长（毫秒）。

column1: * mapFullCombatLogOverride: Always display automatic combat log lines on the left side of map regardless of combat log detail level or UI layout.
column2: * mapFullCombatLogOverride：无论战斗日志详情等级或界面布局如何，始终在地图左侧显示自动战斗日志。

column1: * mapMessageLogMaxLength: Determines the maximum number of message log lines displayed at once at the top-left of the map while using the Modal UI layout. The value must be between 6 and 10 (inclusive).
column2: * mapMessageLogMaxLength：模态界面布局下，地图左上角同时显示的消息日志行数上限。范围6至10（含）。

column1: * mapMessageLogDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) before a given line of on-map message log data will disappear.
column2: * mapMessageLogDuration：地图消息日志每行消失前的显示时长（毫秒）。

column1: * mapCombatLogMaxLength: Determines the maximum number of combat log lines displayed at once at the top-center of the map while using the Modal UI layout. The value must be between 6 and 10 (inclusive). These messages are not shown in that space if mapFullCombatLogOverride active.
column2: * mapCombatLogMaxLength：模态界面布局下，地图顶部中央同时显示的战斗日志行数上限。范围6至10（含）。启用mapFullCombatLogOverride时，此处不显示这些消息。

column1: * mapCombatLogDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) before a given line of on-map combat log data will disappear.
column2: * mapCombatLogDuration：地图战斗日志每行消失前的显示时长（毫秒）。

column1: * mapAlertDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) for which a given ALERT log message mirrored to the map will remain visible.
column2: * mapAlertDuration：镜像到地图的警报日志消息显示时长（毫秒）。

column1: * pauseWaitDurationForEnemies: Number of milliseconds for which to block all wait commands after seeing a new enemy (or only non-disarmed threats if "Stop on Threats Only" option is on). Enemies that move in and out of view will not trigger the block until they haven't been seen for at least 10 turns.
column2: * pauseWaitDurationForEnemies：发现新敌人后，阻止所有等待指令的时长（毫秒）；启用“仅在威胁时停止”时，仅针对未解除武装的威胁。敌人进出视野不会触发阻塞，除非至少10回合未被看到。

column1: * pauseMoveDurationActiveSensor: Number of milliseconds for which to block movement or waiting on coming into range of an enemy's Active Sensor Suite, or 0 to deactivate this feature.
column2: * pauseMoveDurationActiveSensor：进入敌方主动传感器套件范围时，阻止移动或等待的时长（毫秒）。设为0关闭。

column1: * activeSensorWarningBufferRange: Distance outside normal Active Sensor Suite detection range beyond which to reset the warning animation and movement block for a given hostile active sensor user, allowing it to take effect on approaching that enemy again.
column2: * activeSensorWarningBufferRange：超出主动传感器常规探测范围的额外距离；超过后重置该敌方主动传感器使用者的警告动画和移动阻塞，使你再次接近时重新触发。

column1: * flashProjectileVictims: Robots hit by projectiles flash briefly.
column2: * flashProjectileVictims：被投射物击中的机器人会短暂闪烁。

column1: * cogmindPartLossMapIndicator: Choose a style for how to represent Cogmind's own part loss on the map. Defaults to NONE, but other valid options are "COLOR" (flashes red), "X" (flashes a red X), and "NAME" (displays the name of the lost part).
column2: * cogmindPartLossMapIndicator：选择地图上显示Cogmind自身部件损失的方式。默认NONE；也可设为COLOR（闪红）、X（闪红色X）或NAME（显示损失部件名称）。

column1: * alwaysWarnAboutResearchers: Warn about Researchers that will witness an attack even if you've already been scanned.
column2: * alwaysWarnAboutResearchers：即使已被扫描，攻击会被研究员目击时仍发出警告。

column1: * remindCorruptedInventoryOnExit: Warn when about to exit the current map and a corruption-clearing evolution will/might occur but inventory currently contains unattached corrupted parts. Note this must warn for any unidentified exit, even if you know via metaknowledge that the exit will not lead to evolution.
column2: * remindCorruptedInventoryOnExit：即将离开当前地图且进化可能清除损坏、但库存含未安装损坏部件时发出警告。即使凭元知识知道未知出口不会触发进化，也必须对其警告。

column1: * ignoreAscendConfirmation: No confirmation required to exit the current map under normal conditions, but does not block other types of warnings like leaving allies behind.
column2: * ignoreAscendConfirmation：正常情况下离开当前地图无需确认，但离开盟友等其他警告仍会保留。

column1: * ignoreNeutralMeleeConfirmation: No confirmation required for normal movement-based melee attacks against neutral or inactive bots (no affect on force-melee behavior).
column2: * ignoreNeutralMeleeConfirmation：对中立或未激活机器人进行普通移动近战攻击时无需确认（不影响强制近战）。

column1: * ignoreFlyingMeleeConfirmation: No confirmation required for melee attacks while flying (no affect on force-melee behavior).
column2: * ignoreFlyingMeleeConfirmation：飞行时近战攻击无需确认（不影响强制近战）。

column1: * disableSecondPropulsionAutoactivate: Attaching a second (or third, etc.) form of propulsion when another is already active will not autoactive the new form.
column2: * disableSecondPropulsionAutoactivate：已有推进部件启用时，再安装第二种（或更多）推进部件不会自动启用新部件。

column1: * disableVisibleSfx: Deactivate visible sound effect animations outside FOV.
column2: * disableVisibleSfx：关闭视野外可见音效动画。

column1: * disableInfoWindowCloseAnimation: Close robot/item info windows instantly instead of animating their fade.
column2: * disableInfoWindowCloseAnimation：关闭机器人/物品信息窗时立即消失，不播放淡出动画。

column1: * disablePathfindingRobotAvoidance: Mouse pathfinding movement normally avoids blocking non-hostile robots, but disabling it instead stops when blocking, allowing manual redirection rather than letting the game choose the fastest route.
column2: * disablePathfindingRobotAvoidance：鼠标寻路通常会绕开挡路的非敌对机器人；禁用后则会在受阻时停下，让你手动改道，而非由游戏选择最快路线。

column1: * disableManualHackingHelp: Deactivate hacking autocompletion and all automated manual hacking codes assistance.
column2: * disableManualHackingHelp：关闭黑客指令自动补全及所有手动黑客代码辅助。

column1: * disableAutoBackups: Do not make daily backups of the /user/ directory contents.
column2: * disableAutoBackups：不再每日备份/user/目录内容。

column1: * disableEscMenuAccessMouse: In mouse mode, prevents the Escape key from opening the game menu (F1).
column2: * disableEscMenuAccessMouse：鼠标模式下禁用Escape打开游戏菜单（F1）。

column1: * disableEscMenuAccessKeyboard: In Keyboard Mode, prevents the Escape key from opening the game menu (F1).
column2: * disableEscMenuAccessKeyboard：键盘模式下禁用Escape打开游戏菜单（F1）。

column1: * disableSteamRichPresence: By default, if you're playing via Steam then friends will see your current build type, location, and status in game. Setting this to 1 will disable that feature.
column2: * disableSteamRichPresence：Steam版默认向好友显示当前配置、位置和游戏状态。设为1可关闭。

column1: * muteAudioOnFocusLoss: Automatically mute all game audio whenever app focus is lost, for example due to Alt-Tabbing or clicking on a window other than Cogmind. Audio will be restored on returning to the game.
column2: * muteAudioOnFocusLoss：应用失去焦点时（如Alt-Tab或点击Cogmind以外窗口）自动静音；返回游戏后恢复音频。

column1: * muteTextSfx: Silence the standard text/printing sound effects.
column2: * muteTextSfx：静音标准文字/打印音效。

column1: * muteGlobalAlertSfx: Silence alert sound effects played for any non-plot-related global alerts with on-map indicators, such as extermination dispatches, garrison responses, and assaults.
column2: * muteGlobalAlertSfx：静音非剧情全局警报音效，包括地图有指示标记的警报，如歼灭派遣、驻军响应和突击。

column1: * audioLogIncludesFovSounds: Include all non-ambient sound effects even when the origin is currently in view. Note that even when included, the audio log still excludes non-ambient sounds emitted from Cogmind's position, as these are generally Cogmind's own actions and attacks.
column2: * audioLogIncludesFovSounds：即使音效来源在视野内，也将所有非环境音效列入日志。即便启用，Cogmind自身位置发出的非环境音仍会排除，因为通常是Cogmind自己的行动和攻击。

column1: * audioLogIncludesFluffMachines: Include even ambient machine sound effects for those that are mostly fluff, as in they are non-explosive and serve no other special function.
column2: * audioLogIncludesFluffMachines：也将主要用于氛围、非爆炸且无其他特殊功能的机器环境音列入日志。

column1: * audioLogMaxLength: Determines the maximum number of sound effects listed at once, where if the list is full when a new sound needs to be added, the oldest non-ambient sound will be removed to make room. The value must be between 5 and 48 (inclusive).
column2: * audioLogMaxLength：同时列出的音效数上限。列表已满时添加新音效会移除最旧的非环境音腾出位置。范围5至48（含）。

column1: * audioLogDuration: Duration (in milliseconds) before a given non-ambient sound effect entry will disappear from the audio log.
column2: * audioLogDuration：非环境音效条目从音效日志消失前的显示时长（毫秒）。

column1: * blockPartsWindowModKeyInput: Blocks all mod-key based input for Parts window, e.g. Ctrl/Shift/Alt-a~z, for example if one wants to rebind any such key combinations. In such a case, attached part interactions are still accessible via keyboard using the modal part management menu ('p').
column2: * blockPartsWindowModKeyInput：屏蔽部件窗口所有基于修饰键的输入，如Ctrl/Shift/Alt-a~z，便于重新绑定这些组合键。部件交互仍可通过键盘模态部件管理菜单（“p”）进行。

column1: * exposeKeybinds: Once active, this gives access to the keyboard layout and command rebinding system (both external). Read more about this experimental system in the dedicated thread found in the forums General Discussion board: http://www.gridsagegames.com/forums/index.php?topic=823.0
column2: * exposeKeybinds：启用后可访问外部键盘布局和指令重绑定系统。此实验功能详见论坛“综合讨论”版块中的专帖：http://www.gridsagegames.com/forums/index.php?topic=823.0

column1: * runCommandModKey: Normally the 'r'-key is held to enable continuous running movement, though custom input schemes using the command rebinding system may want to reassign this function to a different key. Specify the key to use by its name. Note that it also applies as the modifier key for jumping the cursor in examine mode, particularly with vi and arrows, which cannot use Shift for that purpose like the numpad can.
column2: * runCommandModKey：通常按住“r”可连续奔跑，但使用重绑定系统的自定义方案时可换用其他键。请按键名指定。它也用作检查模式光标跳跃的修饰键，尤其适用于vi键和方向键；它们不像数字键盘那样能以Shift修饰。

column1: * resetAchievements: This value is not present in the file, but may be added manually and set to 1 to erase all previous achievement records. This effect is permanent and you'll have to start from scratch again! Only applies to non-Steam players, since the Steam version automatically syncs achievements again once logged in.
column2: * resetAchievements：文件中默认没有此项；手动添加并设为1可清除所有过往成就记录。此效果永久生效，之后必须从头开始！仅适用于非Steam玩家，因为Steam版登录后会自动重新同步成就。

column1: system.cfg also contains a few settings which can be used to manually adjust system-related features:
column2: system.cfg还包含一些可手动调整系统相关功能的设置：

column1: * mapWidth/mapHeight: These change the dimensions of the map view, in spaces, which in turn affects the size of the entire UI and game window. While the initial values are automatically calculated to give you the maximum font size for your current display, you technically have the option increase the dimensions and see more of the map at once, reducing your maximum available font size as a result. Changing the mapWidth is also a way to convert the game to a 4:3 window on a 16:9 display, in order to have other apps visible beside Cogmind. (Cogmind was designed to work with 4:3, so there are no compromises necessary for that change.)
column2: * mapWidth/mapHeight：设置地图视图宽高（格），也会改变整个界面和游戏窗口尺寸。初始值会自动计算，使当前显示器使用最大字体。你也可增大地图尺寸以一次查看更多地图，但最大可用字体会变小。在16:9显示器上调小mapWidth，也可将游戏改为4:3窗口，让Cogmind旁边显示其他应用。（Cogmind专为4:3设计，调整不会造成妥协。）

column1: * fpsCap: Cap your FPS to the specified value. 0 can be used to completely uncap it.
column2: * fpsCap：将FPS限制为指定值。设为0则不限制。

column1: * showFps: Displays current FPS in program title and on in-game HUD (can toggle via Ctrl-F3).
column2: * showFps：在程序标题和游戏HUD中显示当前FPS（可按Ctrl-F3切换）。

column1: * keyRepeatDelay: Delay (in milliseconds) before holding a key will begin repeating it for input purposes.
column2: * keyRepeatDelay：按住按键后开始重复输入前的延迟（毫秒）。

column1: * keyRepeatInterval: As keyRepeatDelay, but for the interval between subsequent repeated inputs while the key is held.
column2: * keyRepeatInterval：同keyRepeatDelay，但设置按住按键后重复输入之间的间隔。

column1: * noAudio: Prevents loading of any sound effects on startup. This may reduce startup time, though also means sound effects cannot play regardless of mute or volume settings. It also prevents the audio log from being displayed.
