With this setting enabled, if you don't intend to ever use audio you can also safely remove or delete Cogmind's entire data/audio/ directory and the game will load and play normally, just without sound, and total file size is reduced by 35 MB, bringing it to a mere 13 MB.
column2: * noAudio：启动时不加载任何音效，可缩短启动时间，但无论静音或音量设置如何都不会播放音效，也不显示音效日志。若启用此项且不打算使用音频，可安全移除或删除Cogmind整个data/audio/目录；游戏仍可正常运行，只是无声，文件总大小减少35MB，仅13MB。

column1: * deferredAudioLoading: Defer loading of individual audio assets until actually needed by the game. This allows for much faster game startup, and significantly reduced RAM use, but on slower systems if a lot of new sounds are encountered at once could theoretically cause a stutter.
column2: * deferredAudioLoading：将单项音频资源延迟到游戏实际需要时再加载，可显著加快启动并减少内存占用；但较慢的系统若一次遇到许多新音效，理论上可能卡顿。

column1: * unlimitedFontSize: Experimental feature for special monitor setups only! Cogmind can only start up on a system's primary monitor, thus in cases where a secondary monitor has a resolution suitable for a larger font than the primary one, the game cannot take advantage of that in cases where players want to use their secondary monitor. If you have such a setup, set this value to 1 and you will have access to all font sizes regardless of resolution. Then you can set a larger font and once Cogmind is open on the primary monitor, use Shift-WinKey-Left/Right to swap it to the secondary one. If your monitors do not share the same aspect ratio, you may also need to adjust mapWidth/mapHeight accordingly to fit the game on the screen. Unfortunately the library on which Cogmind is built cannot support "fullscreen mode" using a resolution larger than the primary monitor, so this feature is only supported in windowed mode. While in fullscreen mode, you will be unable to select oversized fonts from the options menu. You can set the font size and name in the system.cfg fontSet entry, or within the game while in windowed mode, though because your window may also become too large to access that menu via mouse, know that Ctrl-PgUp/Dn can also be used to cycle through all usable fonts. Overall not ideal but it might satisfy some player's needs so I've exposed this former debug setting as a feature.
column2: * unlimitedFontSize：仅供特殊显示器配置使用的实验功能！Cogmind只能在系统主显示器启动，因此若副显示器分辨率适合更大字体，默认无法利用。此时设为1可不限分辨率使用所有字体尺寸。之后设置较大字体，并在主显示器打开Cogmind，再按Shift-Win键-左/右将窗口移至副屏。若显示器宽高比不同，还可能需调整mapWidth/mapHeight以适应屏幕。Cogmind所用库不支持分辨率超过主显示器的“全屏模式”，因此此功能仅支持窗口模式。全屏时无法在选项菜单选择超大字体；可在system.cfg的fontSet中设置字体名称和尺寸，也可在窗口模式下于游戏中设置。若窗口太大导致鼠标无法操作菜单，可按Ctrl-PgUp/Dn循环所有可用字体。此方案不完美，但可能满足部分玩家需求，因此将原调试项开放为功能。

column1: Normally all files are saved within the Cogmind directory, and you can even play it off a USB stick, but some players may want the option to store their saves and other files elsewhere.
column2: 通常所有文件保存在Cogmind目录中，也可从U盘运行；但有些玩家希望将存档和其他文件放在别处。

column1: You can specify a save path by adding "-customFilePath:PATH" to the COGMIND.exe command line parameters, where PATH is the absolute or relative file path under which to store all settings, scoresheets, screenshots, and the backup archives. Alternatively, the "-nonportable" parameter can be used to automatically assign the path based on the Windows default: "C:\Users\[USER]\.Grid Sage Games\Cogmind"
column2: 可在COGMIND.exe命令行参数中添加“-customFilePath:路径”指定存档路径。路径可为绝对或相对路径，设置、成绩表、截图和备份档案都会存于此处。也可用“-nonportable”按Windows默认路径自动指定：“C:\Users\[USER]\.Grid Sage Games\Cogmind”。

column1: Note that custom file paths are not compatible with Steam Cloud, and like other game-related paths cannot include non-ASCII characters.
column2: 自定义文件路径不兼容Steam云存档；与其他游戏路径一样，不能包含非ASCII字符。

column1: One of Cogmind's original system requirements was based on the fact that its content is designed around ideally having a large number of grid cells visible on the screen at once, thus it was built with the expectation that the device it's played on has a very large screen. As a terminal interface, Cogmind scales directly with physical screen size (resolution is irrelevant), so the best Cogmind experience is had with a suitably large monitor.
column2: Cogmind最初的一项系统需求是屏幕上最好同时显示大量网格，因此设计时假定玩家使用大屏幕。作为终端界面，Cogmind按物理屏幕尺寸直接缩放（与分辨率无关），所以搭配足够大的显示器体验最佳。

column1: That said, numerous accessibility features have been added over the years, both to aid players who may not have access to such a device, and also those with various other needs. Read about these below.
column2: 不过多年来加入了许多无障碍功能，既帮助无法使用大屏幕的玩家，也满足其他需求。详见下文。

column1: There are three different UI layout settings available in the options menu, offering a way to adjust the visual balance between text/tile size and the amount of information displayed at once. Changing this setting requires restarting the game to take effect.
column2: 选项菜单提供三种界面布局，可调整文字/地图块大小与同时显示信息量之间的视觉平衡。更改后需重启游戏才生效。

column1: * Non-modal: Cogmind's original terminal interface layout was designed to target an information-dense 60 rows, providing the largest map view area (>50x50) and access to all main windows at once without having to open them separately. The resulting text size is also therefore the smallest, suitable for large monitors, although map zooming can be most useful in this layout on some devices.
column2: * 非模态：Cogmind原始终端布局面向60行高的信息密集界面，提供最大地图视图（超过50x50），无需单独打开窗口即可同时访问所有主窗口。因此文字最小，适合大屏幕；部分设备上地图缩放在此布局中特别实用。

column1: * Semi-modal: Similar to the non-modal 60-row layout, but with 33% larger text/tiles and a smaller map view (usually 50x35). Also once you have evolved many part slots the inventory window will become modal, meaning it must be opened separately to interact with its contents, although smart autotoggling features take effect under the right conditions. This middle-ground setting is the default.
column2: * 半模态：类似非模态60行布局，但文字/地图块大33%，地图较小（通常50x35）。进化后部件槽很多时，库存窗口会改为模态，必须单独打开才能操作内容；合适情况下会智能自动切换。此折中布局为默认设置。

column1: * Modal: This more extreme setting similarly allows for a larger text/tile size, but in order to further expand the map view (closer to 50x50) all top-side consoles are hidden by default (i.e. the message log, allies menu, intel menu, and combat log). Log contents are temporarily mirrored to the map view, and the related menus and windows can be opened separately if and when needed. Advanced.cfg options allow you to adjust the number and duration of messages shown. If using this layout, selecting Extended Log (F7) or Combat Log (F8) determines which of the two has new messages automatically mirrored below that position on the map. The combat log setting can be further selected a second time to open it as a modal window to recall previous messages, and also give access to the extended combat log history via scrolling.
column2: * 模态：更极端的布局，同样可放大文字/地图块；为进一步扩大地图（接近50x50），默认隐藏所有顶部控制台（消息日志、盟友菜单、情报菜单和战斗日志）。日志内容临时镜像到地图上，需要时可单独打开相关菜单和窗口。可用advanced.cfg选项调整显示消息数量和时长。此布局中，选择扩展日志（F7）或战斗日志（F8）决定地图上该位置下方自动镜像哪类新消息。再次选择战斗日志可将其作为模态窗口打开，以查阅旧消息并滚动查看扩展战斗记录。

column1: The size of the tiles and most text in the map view area can be doubled by toggling with the 'z' key or ZOOM button at the top of the map, or by using the mouse wheel while panning the map with Shift. Considering the scale of Cogmind's maps and ranges at which visual detection, sensor operation, and ranged combat occur (the ranges around which it was designed), playing while frequently zoomed in can be more challenging overall, for which several QoL features were added to help mitigate some drawbacks.
column2: 按“z”或地图顶部的ZOOM按钮，或平移地图时按住Shift滚动鼠标滚轮，可将地图区域的地图块和大部分文字放大一倍。Cogmind地图规模很大，视觉探测、传感器和远程战斗的设计射程也较远；频繁放大游玩整体上更具挑战，因此加入了多项便利功能来缓解不便。

column1: One of the main challenges of having a smaller zoomed view area is the inability to immediately see new terrain and objects coming into view in your direction of exploration. To focus more on a particular direction, hold RMB with the cursor over a map position to designate that as a new relative centerpoint, and all subsequent movement will maintain focus at that same relative direction and distance. Modify this point as often as you like given your needs, or hold RMB on Cogmind to restore the normal centered behavior.
column2: 放大后视野缩小，探索方向上新进入视野的地形和物体可能无法立即看见。要聚焦某个方向，可将光标移到地图位置并按住鼠标右键，将其设为相对中心点；之后移动会持续聚焦于相同方向和距离。可按需随时更改，或在Cogmind身上按住右键恢复常规居中。

column1: Non-mouse players cannot as easily select distant cells, so by default whenever zoomed in Keyboard Mode, regular movement will automatically attempt to adjust the map view so that a more useful or pertinent area is visible at all times. Aside from the default behavior, there are also several other types of automation to choose from. Read about the keyboardMoveViewCenterpointBehaviorFull advanced.cfg option for how to switch to another, or deactivate this feature entirely. None of these methods will be perfect for all situations, but they might save time. They can also feel quite strange at first, but with some experience they might be something you can get used to, or perhaps figure out alternative approaches that work for you using manual assignment.
column2: 键盘玩家不易选择远处格子，因此键盘模式放大时，普通移动默认会自动调整地图视图，始终显示更有用或相关的区域。除默认行为外，还有多种自动方式可选。查阅advanced.cfg中的keyboardMoveViewCenterpointBehaviorFull以切换或完全禁用。没有任何方式适用于所有情形，但可能节省时间。起初可能感觉怪异，熟悉后或许能适应，也可通过手动设定找到适合自己的方法。

column1: As with the mouse, keyboard users can also manually designate a relative centerpoint. This is done with the 's' key in examine mode with the cursor over your desired target cell. Assigning a manual centerpoint deactivates the automation feature until designating Cogmind's own position to reset it, at which point the automated system will again take over. This feature is also useful for quickly recentering the map to reset the automated system, by simply pressing 'x' to enter examine mode followed by an immediate 's'.
column2: 键盘用户也能像鼠标用户一样手动指定相对中心点。在检查模式下，将光标移到目标格并按“s”即可。手动指定后会停用自动功能；指定Cogmind当前位置即可重置并恢复自动调整。此功能也可快速重新居中：按“x”进入检查模式后立即按“s”。

column1: Since you can only see so much at one time while zoomed, only a quarter of the normal map area, there is a good chance that relevant nearby objects will be somewhat beyond the the edges, including even objects otherwise within Cogmind's own FOV. While manually panning the map or designating a centerpoint to keep an eye on a particular direction is useful, and temporarily zooming out to get a general idea of the surroundings is another option, to save time there are a variety of new markers that can appear at the edges of the map view to denote objects in that direction. You'll see markers for offscreen hostiles, non-hostiles (both neutral and friendly), new items, and sensor data. Each marker category uses its own unique background color, and in the case of sensor data is also darker and blinks in and out to reflect the fact that it is not a directly visible object like the others. Items are only marked until automatically labeled for the first time after entering view.
column2: 放大时一次只能看到常规地图的四分之一，因此附近相关物体很可能位于视图边缘之外，甚至可能已在Cogmind视野内。手动平移、指定中心点观察特定方向，或暂时缩小地图了解全局，都能有所帮助；此外地图边缘还会显示新标记，提示该方向的物体。标记包括屏幕外敌人、非敌人（中立和友方）、新物品及传感器数据。各类标记背景色不同；传感器数据更暗并闪烁，表明它不像其他标记那样是直接可见物体。物品只会标记到进入视野后首次自动贴标签为止。

column1: To aid in quickly drawing attention to new incoming threats, if they are visible to Cogmind but not in view at the time the map will automatically shift to show them and pause input for a moment. This behavior can be disabled via the shiftViewForEnemies advanced.cfg option. The map will also shift for certain other events you likely want to be aware of, including Watchers sending out distress signals, Operators preparing to report you, and special proximity pings of nearby machines (all controlled by a separate option: shiftViewForEvents).
column2: 为快速提醒你注意新出现的威胁，若敌人已被Cogmind看见但不在当前视图内，地图会自动移过去显示，并短暂停止输入。可用advanced.cfg的shiftViewForEnemies关闭。某些其他值得注意的事件也会触发视图移动，包括观察者发出求救信号、操作员准备报告你，以及附近特殊机器发出脉冲；由独立选项shiftViewForEvents控制。

column1: Although available even while not zoomed, the <HOSTILES> button that appears above the map while there are hostiles within Cogmind's FOV was added primarily to facilitate play while zoomed in, offering another way to know and confirm that there are hostiles in line of sight, even if not currently in view. The button reports the total enemy count, and can be pressed to focus on and highlight the largest concentration of enemies. Pressing it again restores the centerpoint to its original area, or in some cases if there are other enemies not visible in the first highlight area it may be able to determine that and focus there instead.
column2: 即使未放大也可使用地图上方的<HOSTILES>按钮，但它主要为放大模式设计：只要Cogmind视野中有敌人就会出现，让你确认视线内有敌人，即使他们不在当前视图中。按钮显示敌人总数，点击后会聚焦并高亮敌人最密集处。再次点击会恢复原中心点；若第一处高亮区域外还有敌人，系统有时会识别并改为聚焦那里。

column1: A large range of manually adjusted font styles have been provided in addition to the default font. Cogmind's default font may be less readable for some players, a side effect of all stylistic pixel fonts, so you may consider switching to another one in the options menu. Terminus is an example of a font specifically designed for readability at smaller sizes, so if necessary you can try that option.
column2: 除默认字体外，还提供多种可手动调整的字体。Cogmind默认字体属于像素风，部分玩家可能觉得不易阅读，可在选项菜单换用其他字体。Terminus专为小字号易读性设计，可尝试使用。

column1: Cogmind already starts up using the largest font size available for your current screen (as far as whatever relevant information the device provides it on startup, anyway), so in adjusting this you'll be looking to check out other fonts of the same size but different style. They should be at the top of your list, but the entire list including even smaller sizes is still provided because some people like to play in a smaller window or with a smaller font size combined with an even larger map view.
column2: Cogmind启动时已根据屏幕信息自动使用最大可用字号。因此调整时可先试试同字号的其他风格字体，它们会列在前面。仍提供完整列表（包括更小字号），因为有人喜欢较小窗口，或用较小字体搭配更大地图。

column1: In terms of the map view, while the tiles have been designed with ASCII-like sensibilities, some players have found that in their situation on only borderline acceptably large screens, switching to ASCII mode is a good way to improve readability. Although the majority of players do use the default tileset, Cogmind was designed to be played in ASCII and facilitates this process with useful interface features like an automated labeling system for map objects.
column2: 地图块虽按ASCII风格设计，但部分玩家在屏幕尺寸勉强够用时，切换ASCII模式更易阅读。多数玩家使用默认地图块，不过Cogmind也针对ASCII模式设计，并提供地图物体自动标记等实用功能。

column1: Currently all font sets available by default in the options menu share the same map ASCII style, but for extra readability in ASCII mode some map fonts can be converted from their default appearance to another style through manual activation. Available font sets are controlled via data/fonts/_config.xt, so to add any of the following alternatives, open that file and activate any additional fonts you'd like to try by removing the two slashes at the beginning of their corresponding line to allow them to appear on the in-game list:
column2: 选项菜单默认提供的字体集目前都使用相同地图ASCII风格。若想在ASCII模式下提高可读性，可手动启用其他风格的地图字体。字体集由data/fonts/_config.xt控制；要添加下列替代字体，打开该文件并删除对应行开头的两个斜杠，即可在游戏列表中启用：

column1: Although these settings only affect those who use the indicated font sizes (fullscreen or windowed), more map ASCII alternatives can be added upon request if compatible with the desired size.
column2: 这些设置仅影响使用指定字号（全屏或窗口）的玩家。如需兼容目标尺寸，还可按需添加更多地图ASCII字体。

column1: Although Cogmind was designed and balanced for its hardest mode, naturally some players simply don't have the time or inclination to strive for mastery, thus alternative modes are available that tweak multiple aspects of the game to make survival easier. You can read much more about these modes and their full effects under the Difficulty section towards the beginning of this manual.
column2: Cogmind按最难模式设计和平衡，但部分玩家没有时间或意愿精通游戏，因此提供了调整多项机制、让生存更容易的替代模式。详细效果见本手册前部“难度”章节。

column1: Some players prefer to explore the world of Cogmind using more typical RPG-like XP leveling mechanics and permanent upgrades instead of Cogmind's standard evolution and attrition systems. Originally created as a special event in 2019, "RPGLIKE" is still available and advertised as a serious alternative for those who prefer that sort of gameplay. This special mode significantly changes the experience, and in most respects is generally much easier, but has at least allowed some players to get more of what they want out of their time with Cogmind. You can read more about RPGLIKE and its implications, and how to activate it, under the Alternative Rules section of this manual.
column2: 有些玩家更喜欢传统RPG式XP升级与永久强化，而非Cogmind标准的进化和消耗机制。RPGLIKE最初于2019年作为特别活动推出，至今仍作为严肃替代玩法提供。此模式显著改变体验，大多数方面会容易得多，但确实让部分玩家更能享受Cogmind。详情及启用方式见本手册“替代规则”。

column1: By default Cogmind uses a 16px hardware cursor, but that may not be suitable at extremely high resolutions depending on OS cursor scaling settings. If the cursor appears too small (or for some other reason you'd prefer a different style), Cogmind includes a way to display a much more flexible software cursor.
column2: Cogmind默认使用16px硬件光标，但在极高分辨率下，操作系统的光标缩放可能使其不合适。若光标太小，或你偏好其他样式，可使用Cogmind提供的灵活软件光标。

column1: Simply put a file named "cursor.png" in the /rex/ directory and it will be detected automatically on startup. Any image dimensions are accepted, and any pixels that use the hot pink color (255,0,255) will be transparent (see samples provided in that directory). The top-left corner (position 0,0) is always considered the "hotspot," or where the click is actually detected.
column2: 只需将名为“cursor.png”的文件放入/rex/目录，启动时便会自动识别。图像尺寸不限；使用亮粉色（255,0,255）的像素会透明（目录中有示例）。左上角（位置0,0）始终视为“热点”，即实际检测点击的位置。

column1: Note that a software cursor may feel slightly sluggish compared to a hardware cursor if FPS is low, or even while maintaining the normal 60 FPS cap. Using the system.cfg option to raise the cap will likely resolve the issue as long as your CPU is fast enough to push the frame rate even higher.
column2: 请注意，帧率较低时，软件光标可能比硬件光标略显迟缓；即使维持默认60FPS上限也可能如此。只要CPU足够快、能推动更高帧率，提高system.cfg中的上限通常就能解决。

column1: Toggling Colorblind Adjustment in the options menu makes various color-based adjustments to parts of the interface that may help certain players.
column2: 在选项菜单切换色盲调整，会对界面若干颜色进行调整，或可帮助部分玩家。

column1: * Neutral 0b10 bots show as light gray instead of green
column2: * 中立0b10机器人显示为浅灰色而非绿色

column1: * Most orange UI colors instead appear azure blue
column2: * 大部分橙色界面改为天蓝色

column1: * Most green UI colors are converted to light gray
column2: * 大部分绿色界面改为浅灰色

column1: * HUD Core/Energy/Matter readout uses higher contrast colors
column2: * HUD核心/能量/物质读数使用高对比度颜色

column1: While some effects will take place immediately on toggling this option, fully applying it requires a manual restart.
column2: 切换后部分效果立即生效，但需手动重启才能完全应用。

column1: Consider combining Colorblind Adjustments with the BRIGHTNESS renderFilter described below, or try SHIFT_HUE.
column2: 可将色盲调整与下文所述BRIGHTNESS渲染滤镜结合，或尝试SHIFT_HUE。

column1: Custom UI and map color schemes are currently controlled via two advanced.cfg settings: renderFilter and renderFilterMap. These can be used to specify one or more filters that adjust the appearance of the map and/or UI as a whole. For example, renderFilter=BRIGHTNESS(80) will set the brightness of the entire game to 80% of what it is by default. Or renderFilterMap=BRIGHTNESS(80) will only darken the map.
column2: 自定义界面和地图配色由advanced.cfg的renderFilter与renderFilterMap控制，可指定一个或多个滤镜调整地图和/或整个界面。例如renderFilter=BRIGHTNESS(80)可将全游戏亮度设为默认的80%；renderFilterMap=BRIGHTNESS(80)则只调暗地图。

column1: Each setting supports mixing as many filters as you want, though remember that each additional filter requires more processing time per frame. Combine filters by separating them with '|'. E.g., renderFilter=BRIGHTNESS(90)|SATURATION(90) lowers both the brightness and saturation by 10%. If there are multiple filters they are applied in the order listed, and all map filters are applied before any program-wide filters.
column2: 每项设置都可混合任意数量滤镜，但每增加一个都会增加每帧处理时间。用“|”分隔滤镜即可组合。例如renderFilter=BRIGHTNESS(90)|SATURATION(90)会同时降低亮度和饱和度各10%。多个滤镜按列出顺序应用，所有地图滤镜先于全局滤镜应用。

column1: The available filters are as follows:
column2: 可用滤镜如下：

column1: * NONE: The default appearance.
column2: * NONE：默认外观。

column1: * BRIGHTNESS(X): Set the color brightness to X, usually a value from 1~100. Perceived color brightness is not linear, but adding in more complex calculations to compensate would slow it down so this is a direct percentage modifier. As a reference, setting to something like 70-80 is darker but maybe not too dark, depending on your monitor. Values above 100 will increase brightness, for example 150 makes everything 50% brighter, 200 doubles brightness, etc.
column2: * BRIGHTNESS(X)：将颜色亮度设为X，通常取1~100。感知亮度并非线性；更复杂的补偿计算会降低速度，因此此项直接按百分比调整。可参考70~80，通常会变暗但不至于太暗，具体取决于显示器。高于100会变亮，例如150亮50%，200则亮度翻倍。

column1: * SATURATION(X): Set the color saturation to X, usually a value from 0~100. Most colors in Cogmind are fully saturated, and this value can be used to take the edge off. As a reference, try something like 66.
column2: * SATURATION(X)：将颜色饱和度设为X，通常取0~100。Cogmind大多数颜色都是全饱和的，此项可降低鲜艳程度。可尝试66左右。

column1: * SWAP: Swaps the foreground and background colors. While the UI generally looks terrible in this state, it may be your thing when applied to the map, or at least fun to toy around with.
column2: * SWAP：交换前景和背景色。界面整体通常会变得很难看，但地图上可能适合你，至少也值得玩玩。

column1: * SHIFT_HUE(X): Shift/rotate the hue of the entire palette by X, a value from 1~360. Blacks stay black, grays stay gray, but all other colors will become something else. For example, a value of 180 will create a mostly pink UI, 90 is blue, and 270 is orange. Negative values can be used, and will automatically be converted to the proper value within the range.
column2: * SHIFT_HUE(X)：将整个调色板色相偏移/旋转X，范围1~360。黑色和灰色不变，其他颜色都会改变。例如180会让界面大多呈粉色，90为蓝色，270为橙色。支持负数，并会自动换算到范围内。

column1: * SHIFT_RGB(X): Shifts all RGB color values by X, a number from 1~255. The shifting will ignore any blacks, but this filter is terrible for pretty much anything except creating... color chaos. Negative values can be used, and will automatically be converted to the proper value within the range.
column2: * SHIFT_RGB(X)：将所有RGB颜色值偏移X，范围1~255。忽略黑色；除了制造色彩混乱，此滤镜几乎毫无用处。支持负数，并会自动换算到范围内。

column1: * INVERT: Also known as the negative effect, this inverts all foreground and background RGB values. This mode results in a light-themed interface, and can look decent when combined with other modes such as low-contrast (resulting in a brighter pastel effect) and possibly map swapping. However, inversion works much better in ASCII mode instead of with tiles due to the shading method used in the tiles art.
column2: * INVERT：又称负片效果，反转所有前景和背景RGB值，形成浅色主题。与低对比度等模式结合（可形成更亮的柔和色调），或配合地图颜色交换，效果可能不错。由于地图块的着色方式不同，反转在ASCII模式下比地图块模式效果更好。

column1: The following additional filters are only applicable to renderFilter, not the map-only version:
column2: 以下附加滤镜仅适用于renderFilter，不适用于仅作用于地图的版本：

column1: * AUTUMN: A custom low-contrast mode that converts black backgrounds to dark maroon, and raises the brightness of all darker foreground colors while also slightly darkening the brightest foreground colors to take their edge off. In this mode some of the ASCII item art may look a little odd (and not as good), as will parts of the intro and ending animations, but this only affects the minority of areas that use their own background colors. Further time might be invested in overcoming some of the remaining aesthetic challenges of implementing low-contrast modes if it seems like they're being used.
column2: * AUTUMN：自定义低对比度模式，将黑色背景改为深栗色；提高较暗前景色亮度，并略微降低最亮前景色以柔化效果。此模式下部分ASCII物品图案可能显得怪异、不够美观，开场和结尾动画的部分区域也会如此；这只影响少数使用自定义背景色的区域。若低对比度模式有人使用，之后或可进一步改善其美观问题。

column1: * SLEEPY: A custom low-contrast mode like AUTUMN but with a comfortable blueish background.
column2: * SLEEPY：类似AUTUMN的自定义低对比度模式，背景为舒适的浅蓝色。

column1: * LOW_CONTRAST(R,G,B): Aside from the AUTUMN and SLEEPY presets, you can also use this filter to create your own low-contrast mode by specifying the RGB values of the desired background color. It should be something relatively dark.
column2: * LOW_CONTRAST(R,G,B)：除AUTUMN和SLEEPY预设外，也可指定所需背景色的RGB值，自制低对比度模式。建议使用较暗的颜色。

column1: Note that any filter changes affecting color that are made while a run is in progress will in some cases cause areas outside FOV to appear strangely until leaving for a new map.
column2: 注意：游戏中更改颜色滤镜时，视野外区域有时会暂时显示异常，直到进入新地图才恢复。

column1: Off by default but available in the Audio section of the options menu, activating this log lists sound effects at the top-right corner of the map view. Ambient sounds are always listed, while non-ambient sounds are only shown when the origin is outside Cogmind's FOV. Ambient sounds are listed first, followed by a separator, then any non-ambient sound effects.
column2: 默认关闭，但可在选项菜单“音频”中开启。启用后，地图视图右上角会列出音效。环境音始终显示；非环境音仅在来源位于Cogmind视野外时显示。环境音列在前，中间以分隔线隔开，之后列出非环境音效。

column1: The audio log is meant to be an accessibility feature akin to closed captions, allowing anyone who keeps their volume low or muted to be able to retain access to important audio knowledge (alongside the visible SFX feature). A given sound's volume must be at least 10% to be included in the log, since anything lower is not generally audible anyway, and it keeps the log cleaner and more focused.
column2: 音效日志是一项类似隐藏字幕的无障碍功能，让音量较低或静音的玩家也能获取重要音频信息（并配合可视音效）。音量至少达到10%的声音才会列入日志，因为更低通常听不见，也能让日志更清晰、聚焦。

column1: In choosing what sounds to report in the audio log, in most cases it was geared towards information that is strategically helpful to know when out of view, rather than providing an exhaustive list. That said, almost no door actions are reflected, since even if out of view they are clearly displayed via the visible SFX system, and their frequency is often rather high. An exception was made for phase walls, since those are strategically important but do not reveal their precise location as a visible SFX source. Other sounds that have clear visual alternatives are also generally excluded to avoid adding unnecessary "noise" in the audio log, for example dispatch alerts, and the EMP charging and discharging in Waste (which come with their own graphics and messages).
column2: 音效日志主要报告视野外有策略价值的信息，而非详尽罗列。大多数开关门声不会显示，因为即使门在视野外，也会通过可视音效明确显示，而且出现频率很高。相位墙是例外：它们具有策略价值，但可视音效不会透露精确位置。其他有明确视觉替代提示的声音通常也会排除，以免日志产生多余“噪声”；例如调度警报，以及废土中的EMP充放电（均有专属图像和消息）。

column1: Note that weapon sounds do not necessarily list the specific weapon name, but instead the base name for the sound. For example there are a number of railgun variants that use the same sound, and the audio log will not differentiate between them, simply listing each as a "Railgun," but any weapons with unique sounds are indicated by their specific name where applicable.
column2: 武器音效未必会显示具体武器名称，而是显示声音的基础名称。例如多种轨道炮变体共用同一音效，日志只会统一显示“轨道炮”，不会区分；有独特音效的武器则会在适用时显示专属名称。

column1: There are several advanced.cfg options for customizing the audio log behavior. Aside from those, be aware that using the noAudio system.cfg setting, or muting the audio (for example via Ctrl-F11), will also automatically prevent the audio log from displaying any sounds. You can, however, simultaneously achieve a muting effect and retain audio log information by setting the Master Volume in the options to 0.
column2: 可通过多个advanced.cfg选项自定义音效日志。另请注意，使用system.cfg的noAudio设置或静音（如Ctrl-F11）都会自动阻止音效日志显示声音。但可将选项中的主音量设为0，在静音的同时保留日志信息。

column1: In addition to the normal options found in the in-game options menu, over 100 more specific options have been implemented to allow further tweaking of the interface appearance and its behavior. You can read more about these and how to adjust them in Advanced Options under the Advanced UI section of this manual.
column2: 除游戏内选项菜单中的常规选项外，游戏还提供100多项细化设置，以进一步调整界面外观和行为。详见“高级界面”章节的“高级选项”。

column1: While it's recommended to use the in-game basic and advanced command lists that show commands within the window to which they apply, commands are also listed here as an alternative way to reference them (and so that they can all be viewed externally in the text version of this manual).
column2: 建议优先使用游戏内基础/高级指令列表，它们会在对应窗口中显示指令；此处也列出指令，供替代查阅，并可在文本版手册中集中浏览。

column1: Anyone preferring to manage parts via keyboard input without using any Ctrl/Shift/Alt modifiers can access all the same functionality via the modal part management menu. Press 'p' to activate the menu and see the full list of options, then select a submenu option and appropriate target letter or number. In this mode Drop always refers to a direct drop to the ground, even if there is sufficient inventory space to hold a dropped attached item. Use Remove to instead attempt to put it in inventory first, or on the ground if not enough capacity.
column2: 不想使用Ctrl/Shift/Alt修饰键、偏好纯键盘管理部件的玩家，可通过模态部件管理菜单使用相同功能。按“p”打开菜单查看完整选项，再选择子菜单项和目标字母或数字。在此模式中，“丢弃”始终直接丢到地面，即使库存有空间容纳被卸下的部件也一样。若想先放入库存、容量不足时再丢到地面，请改用“移除”。
